| | Hi, Peter, I hope your week is off to a good start. I wanted to share with you something funny that I’ve noticed my opponent likes to do – misspell my name. You see, he thinks my name is “Eric SorenSON,” not Eric SorenSEN. It’s not the first time it’s happened, but I do find it funny that someone who is going to spend millions of dollars against me can’t even spell my name correctly. It does make some sense, though. After all, the person he says I am has no real resemblance to me or the work I’ve done in Washington.

* For another, he claims I’m “ignoring my constituents and playing party politics.” **That may be true of “Eric SorenSON,” but it’s definitely not true of me, Eric Sorensen.** In just the past year, my team has closed 1,200 constituent services cases. name: Joe Biden
subject: When you elected me to this office, I promised to always level with you, to tell you the truth. And the truth is, the sacred cause of this country is larger than any one of us.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
Peter, those of us who cherish that cause -- the cause of American democracy itself -- must unite to protect it. That’s what I am asking you to do today. | | |
---
Peter -- As I’ve sat in the Oval Office over the last four years, I have been surrounded by portraits of extraordinary American presidents. Thomas Jefferson, who wrote the immortal words that guide this nation. George Washington, who showed us presidents are not kings. Abraham Lincoln, who implored us to reject malice. Franklin Roosevelt, who inspired us to reject fear. _I revere this office, but I love my country more._ It’s been the honor of my life to serve as your President and to have had your support throughout my campaign for reelection. But defending our democracy is more important than any title. America is at an inflection point, one of those rare moments in history when the decisions we make now will determine the fate of our nation and the world for decades to come. America is going to have to choose between moving forward or backward, between hope and hate, between unity and division. We have to decide: _Do we still believe in honesty, decency, and respect; freedom, justice, and democracy?_ When you elected me to this office, I promised to always level with you, to tell you the truth. body:
Truth is, Kamala Harris needs a strong Congress to help her get the work done. Help me be that supportive Representative by donating today.💸

** Donate for Democracy!
------------------------------------------------------------

** "If You Want Democracy, You Have to Vote For It..."
------------------------------------------------------------

With the change in the top of the Democratic ticket, you're being bombarded with emails asking for your donation. I'll admit, this is another one, but donating to this cause will help underscore your investment in Kamala Harris (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=ca9a65aa65-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_07_30_05_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ca9a65aa65-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

I was thrilled to be a part of the opening of the Democrat HQ in Forsyth County on Sunday. The event was full of undeniable energy that made me confident that Kamala will win in November. Unfortunately, the thought that followed that is "and Republicans will win control of Congress".

That thought terrifies me. All the hope we have now for our party will be blocked by the same kind of do-nothing Congress that has plagued us for far too long. To put it plainly, Democrats like me need to be elected to Congress to help secure the promise we feel right now and the best way to do that is to donate to Democratic Congressional Candidates. My name is Bob Christian and I am asking you to donate to my campaign for US House of Representatives for North Georgia's 7th congressional district. (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=ca9a65aa65-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_07_30_05_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ca9a65aa65-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

My opponent has $1,613,548.96 in reported contributions right now. I have brought in $16,437.76 -- just 1% of my opponent who in his first 2 years as your Representative has:
* Continued to deny climate change
* Did not ask for federal dollars that can be used to build roads and infrastructure needed to support the growth in North Georgia
* Attacked Dr. Fauci during a House Select Subcommittee on the Coronavirus, using the time to lash out for his perceived slights

Worse, through his personal behavior -- crossing guard rails in the Capitol Building to do pullups from the top of the rotunda and beginning a marriage-ending affair with a House colleague -- my opponent demonstrates a belief that he is above the rules.

** You Have to Vote For Change...With Your Dollars
------------------------------------------------------------

Your donation to my campaign will help me get to the House of Representatives to respectfully and responsibly support the legislative goals of a President Harris. (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=ca9a65aa65-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_07_30_05_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ca9a65aa65-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

name: Jill Stein
subject: It’s Disability Pride Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=disability_rights&n=1)
---
Peter,

When LBJ signed Medicare and Medicaid into law 59 years ago today, it established a standard for healthcare access for our most vulnerable citizens.

These are still two of our most important federal programs. But the original legislation left a LOT of gaps for people living with disabilities – the population most likely to be using Medicare or Medicaid.

25 years later, the Americans with Disabilities Act was passed to address those gaps (and countless more).

It’s difficult to imagine a time before the ADA now, but as a doctor of internal medicine who practiced for over two decades, I can tell you that the reforms brought about by this landmark civil rights legislation have changed the world.

**Many features of public life that we take for granted today, like wheelchair accessible buildings and sidewalks, closed captioning on TV and video streaming services, even automatic doors on public buildings – none of that was standard in the pre-ADA world.

** The ADA introduced new standards that spread around the world – transforming the lives of billions and allowing people living with disabilities to participate more fully in every aspect of our society.

**But the ADA is now 34 years old, and it’s long overdue for an upgrade.

****Our campaign is the only one in this race with a[ comprehensive platform recognizing disability rights as human rights](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=disability_rights&n=2) – not an afterthought.**[****](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=disability_rights&n=3)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=disability_rights&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=disability_rights&n=4)
---
My administration will guarantee as a human right that every person living with disabilities – whether visible or invisible – is free from ableist policies that harm and isolate them.

We will end disparities in pay, benefits, housing, healthcare, and education, and commit to disability inclusion and representation at all levels of public life.

All people, including those with disabilities, have the right to contribute their talents and participate fully in a diverse and thriving society.

As your president I commit to:
* Providing economic security for people with disabilities by ending discrimination in wage laws and enforcing workplace protections – and expanding Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Social Income (SSI)

* Imposing standards to make all new technology accessible and supportive of the diverse lives of people with disabilities

* Provide children with disabilities with life-changing early interventions

* Defend the civil liberties of people with disabilities in areas like criminal justice, voting, physical and mental health, parental rights, and marriage equality

* Upgrade all existing public housing and public schools to ADA accessibility standards

* Eliminate small business exemptions to the ADA; Appropriate federal funds to support small businesses who hire people with disabilities in meeting their accommodation needs

* Recognize long COVID as a major contributor to the rapidly expanding population of disabled Americans, and implement federal systems of support to study the effects of long COVID and recommend policy changes to ensure those affected have the appropriate protections in their workplace, housing, healthcare, and other needs.

...and much more.

Too often, people living with disabilities are treated like an afterthought, slipping through the cracks of legislation that was never crafted with their needs in mind.

Together, we will change that.

**You can read my full platform on**[**Disability Rights here**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=disability_rights&n=5)**.

**[**Finally, I need your help to make this vision a reality. While corporate PACs and mega-donors are rushing to fill the coffers of the twin parties of war and Wall Street, our success depends on you – the ONLY campaign on the ballot for the majority of voters that can’t be bought by special interests. Can you donate $34 to celebrate 34 years of the ADA today?**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=disability_rights&n=6)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=disability_rights&n=7 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=disability_rights&n=7)
---
For too long, people living with disabilities have been forced into the shadows, coping with a world that isn’t built for their needs, and rarely invited into the conversation where decisions that affect their lives are made.

The ADA was a major leap forward and one of the most significant pieces of civil rights legislation in our nation’s history.

Now it’s time for the next leap.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

body:
| Friends -

It is amazing how quickly a campaign can go from slow-and-steady to feeling like you're living every day in the middle of a whirlwind.

But that's where we are.

We had the attempted assassination of Trump, Trump named his VP from Ohio (of all places, please!), my potential opponent attacked me on stage at the Republican National Convention, and Joe Biden ended his campaign and endorsed Kamala Harris... all in 3 weeks.

And we're not done.

On August 6th, we’re going to know who our general election opponent is. Kamala Harris will name her VP and the Democratic National Convention will happen in just a few weeks. Wild times.

But I write because in the midst of ~ all this ~ going on, we can't let our race get lost in the shuffle. Because control of the Senate is at stake. And when our opponent is formally named, they are going to inherit the full support of the Republican Party. And we have to be ready. So I am asking:

Earlier this year, I stood up for Veterans and Italian Americans at a Board of Ed Meeting in Stamford and wrote an article, "First They Came For....... Our Veterans And Our Italian Americans In Stamford" (see [Article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d76980a5-6160-4d2f-99cc-7af9d364bc78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
This was in response to the Stamford Board of Ed and its removal of Veterans Day and Columbus Day from the School holidays in the Stamford Public Schools. **To remove Columbus Day and Veterans Day is simply a way to erase our history and many schools have already eliminated the observance of these holidays.**
_**Veterans Day is a clear reminder that freedom is not free.**_
_**Removal of Columbus Day is an attempt to erase our rich Italian heritage and culture woven into the fabric of America.**_
**About 150 upset Veterans and Americans (many of them were Italian-American Veterans) showed up to voice our opposition. I attended as this is an important issue to me.** There were only two sitting republicans present there ([Tom O'Day ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d71a7a53-5a7b-474c-8042-660c5093fdb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and [Ryan Fazio](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/42b00652-adef-472a-be38-c73b59cc4ab1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) and one candidate for State Rep ([Tina Courpas](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/93c99de9-28ef-4436-bf69-4fdd4bdeabd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). T**HERE WERE NO DEMOCRATS THAT CAME TO STAND UP FOR VETS AND THE ITALIAN AMERICANS.**
_**Don 't forget those names in November but remember GOLDSTEIN on August 13th!!**_
In my last run for Congress two years ago and throughout this campaign, we had tremendous support from our Veterans and that has only continued as we visit **VFWs and meet veterans on the campaign trail.**
We are hearing stories about how veterans are ignored with health care issues from the VA. These veterans are disgusted that they have life-long injuries that are not being cared for **while** **they see illegals that cross the border and get treated better than they are with better housing and healthcare**. The Democrats have not only abandoned the working class but they have fully abandoned those who have served our nation.
Over the weekend, we spoke to a vet with PTSD and he is lucky to get treated as he understands the paperwork. Most veterans do not have that same experience as they cannot navigate the bureaucracy.
Other veterans I spoke to this weekend and over the course of the campaign have housing issues. They can no longer afford to live in the district on their fixed incomes as housing prices have increased along with the other cost of living increases of food, electricity and gas. **We are at a crossroads where our veterans are being looked over by their nation that they served.**
While America and the Democrats abandon its veterans, the veterans are helping each other through support groups. We met a vet in Oxford who is part of the Connecticut chapter of the Combat Veteran Motorcycle Association 31-2 (See their [website](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f2912fe7-0d0f-48e1-9348-ae7382e95802?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/92ebc9c1-1c13-4b36-903b-78ce574dd679?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Source ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5c2185b2-b176-4907-93de-fa681d87e638?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This Veteran gave us a wristband of this group that says "I Support Combat Vets!" I responded back that I support you as well and thanked him for his service.
**VETERANS ARE THE LUCKY SOLDIERS WHO MAKE IT HOME AFTER DEFENDING OUR CONSTITUTION AND OUR WAY OF LIFE. THEY DESERVE BETTER.**
**To come back and not be welcome home and be treated worse than illegals is disgusting as the excessive illegal immigration under the Biden/Himes Administration has changed the landscape of this nation.** We have a border problem in Connecticut and under the Biden/Himes era, Connecticut has become a border state. _**As our border is invaded from the south, there has been a rise of anti-American sentiment from such illegal immigrants along with people that live in America that denounce this great nation.**_
_**Old Glory Is Under Attack**_
Over the past week and over the past few months, our American Flag has been attacked while the progressives seem to think Old Glory is a symbol of oppression. **We have seen pro-Palestinian supporters across this nation burn down the flag on college campuses and last week in front of Congress to protest American support for Israel.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/936aec6b-89cc-4678-8b32-0dde1b8d31f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c122594a-b300-4ece-85be-3a8bb99d8cb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

**WHAT ABOUT THE VETS?**
Earlier this year, I met Robert Wilkie, the former Secretary of Veterans Affairs under the the Trump Administration. He is a remarkable man and really improved patient outcomes for our veterans and focused efforts on the issues that really impact our veterans like suicide prevention, opioid abuse and addiction. Wilkie also worked to create educational opportunities for veterans.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9e55d38d-5bb4-44a7-82f2-034225da15c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
During his time as VA secretary, Wilkie helped improve the VA's performance of vital health services to our 9.5 million veterans; he did this while restoring trust in the VA health care system by improving outpatient services and bringing VA services to veterans in their local communities under the implementation of the MISSION Act. Wilkie helped modernize the VA's health record system. Our healthcare system needs more modernization. **Our Veterans need to have less paperwork and more care**.
As a physician, health administration and recordkeeping costs are some of the largest costs of healthcare and my platform is focused on reducing healthcare costs by reducing the administrative burden and excessive paperwork that does not improve patient outcomes. I believe that healthcare costs have at least a trillion dollars of admin waste that could be eliminated without sacrificing patient outcomes.
**I will certainly make Veteran Issues a priority on day one if elected to Congress. I will do that on my trip to the border to shut it down unlike Kamala Harris our border czar who shirked all responsibilities.**
**On August 13 th, Stand up for the physician candidate who wants to improve healthcare for our veterans and their other needs by Voting GOLDSTEIN ON AUGUST 13. - Early Voting Starts August 5-11.**
I would be honored by your support. _**I am the People 's Candidate and in politics its about serving you the people.**_
Sharing is Caring - so if you like the message please pass it on.
Thank you for your continued support.

Zach Rehl is a patriot, and he urgently needs your help.

Zach received an honorable discharge from the US Marine Corps, and a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**The FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen Presidential election at the US Capitol on January 6th, 2021.**

But you and I don't have to sit there and take it.

That means their criminal convictions can be thrown out. And their criminal trials must stop.**

This powerful new lawsuit will rein in the FBI, too.

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 41 years.

You've seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And with my critically important new case, I can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

If we win, that means their criminal convictions can be thrown out. And their criminal trials must stop.

Let me tell you, these lawsuits are very expensive and time consuming.

But Zach and his fellow January patriots and their families are worth it.

**[Patriot, PLEASE help me GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zio1n0alm8c5tmqqjli9r8pqclb20skr5gdjj4i0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2c5h6cor2cth2bs)**

You and I can make a huge difference for suffering patriots if we take these lawsuits all the way.

Larry Klayman

name: Jim Carris
subject: Our Journey to a More Prosperous District
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Carris for Congress
body:
No images? [Click here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-e-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-yk/) Team Carris,Some days when I read the news, it feels indistinguishable from satire. Despite the Democratic gaslighting that inflation is no longer a factor, and that families and the middle class are doing fine - myths perpetuated by my opponent - many families in Illinois are facing a starkly different reality. The cost of living continues to rise, making it increasingly difficult for families to make ends meet. Prices for essential goods such as gas, groceries, healthcare, and housing are climbing, leaving many to wonder if the inflation rate touted by officials truly reflects their day-to-day experiences.Our leaders need to wake up and stop perpetuating media myths creating a false sense of security. Families are hurting! A [recent Bankrate survey](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-r/), 60% of employed Americans said **their income and wages have not kept up with increasing prices**. What's more:
* The [median home price](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-y/) in IL-10 has **risen by around 8%** with [Illinois Policy](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-j/) reporting that almost one-third of Illinois households are "housing burdened" and paying at least 30% of their income on housing in the midst of a housing affordability crisis
* The cost of goods and services in Illinois has **risen more than 17%** since 2021, according to an [inflation tracker](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-t/) created by Congress' Joint Economic Committee
* The average Illinois household needs about **$1,111 more per month** to afford the same expenses they had in January 2021 according to the Joint Economic Committee
* Our District's gasoline prices soared from from $2.50 per gallon to **over $4.20** per gallon since this administration took office

Source: [JEC Republicans State Inflation Tracker](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-i/)Adding to this burden is the state's high unemployment rate, which remains a pressing issue for countless residents. Illinois' June 2024 unemployment rate was**5%** , the **[third-worst](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-d/)****in the U.S.** according to the [U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-h/); this translates to approximately **328,000** Illinoisans looking for work. Job opportunities are scarce, and those available often do not offer wages that keep pace with the escalating cost of living. This economic squeeze is creating a precarious situation for many **middle-class families who feel left behind** by policies that seem disconnected from their struggles.Yet, my opponent would have you believe otherwise, because it has all happened under his watch! The gaslighting continues - while Democrats emphasize their efforts to combat inflation and support the middle class, the tangible impact on Illinois families tells a different story. **The disconnect between political rhetoric and on-the-ground reality** is growing, highlighting the need for **more effective and immediate measures** to address these pressing economic challenges. For many Illinoisans, the promised relief feels distant, and **the fight for a stable financial future continues.**

**My platform IS the District 's families' platform. I am a husband, father, and businessman like so many of you. I will fight to lower and cut taxes for you. I will bring jobs to Illinois and create economic opportunity zones in communities that need long-term financial investment to succeed and I will push for energy independence for the United States - the cornerstone of a good economy. ****This November - the election is about you and my commitment is to never lose sight of that when I am in Congress. ** Jim Carris
Candidate for Congress **Support Carris for Congress - Give Today!** Jim is on a mission to bring independence, compassion, and common sense to Washington. **Your continued financial support will help us reach more voters through our grassroots organizing efforts.** Together, we can secure a win for Illinois and for our country! [Give $25 Today](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-k/) **Meet Jim at an Upcoming Event** **Mark Your Calendars - Early Voting Begins on September 26!** **Lake County Voter Information**
* [ Lake County Clerk's Office](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-n/)
* [Lake County Voter Power](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-p/) - An interactive database that displays voter address-specific information about districts, elected officials, candidates, sample ballot, early and Election Day voting sites, and allows you to request a Vote by Mail ballot.

**McHenry County Voter Information**
* [ McHenry County Clerk's Office](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-x/)

**North Suburban Cook County Voter Information**
* [ Cook County Clerk's Office](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-m/)
* [Your Voter Information](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-c/) - An interactive database that displays voter address-specific information about districts, elected officials, candidates, sample ballot, and early and Election Day voting sites.

**Illinois State Board of Elections Voter Information**
* [ Early Voting Locations](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-q/)
* [Vote by Mail Online Application Link](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-a/)
* [Registration Lookup](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-f/)
* [Polling Place Lookup](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-z/)

**On the Road in #IL10** 🇺🇸 **Building Strong Relationships for Stronger Communities**
I attended an event with the Illinois Black Republican Caucus and IL GOP Chair Kathy Salvi and the energy in the room was electric. The Democratic party has taken many important groups in our communities for granted and we're building strong relationships with these groups that were previously ignored. 🇺🇸 **Celebrating Lake County and Republicans at the County Fair**
We made some great memories at the Lake County Fair! The Lake County Republicans' booth was a key attraction for fair attendees and we had a chance to walk around and meet many wonderful families, vendors, and Lake County residents. We talked about the history of the District and the lack of focus on District families by our current representative. 🇺🇸 **Enjoying Time with the Greek Orthodox Community**
Some of our Team Carris interns joined me at St. Demetrios Greek Orthodox Church in Libertyville for Greek Fest! It was a wonderful day spent with parishioners enjoying authentic Greek food, dancing, and Greek culture. Opa! 🇺🇸 **Heading West: Spending Time in McHenry County**
My family and I attended the McHenry County Republican Party's Grand Old Party at Richardson Farm! In addition to speaking about my platform to attendees, we met so many wonderful families and McHenry residents who are new to the 10th District and are eager to feel included in Washington. **Invite Jim to Your Next Event!** Are you interested in hosting a meet and greet for Team Carris or inviting Jim to your event? Email us at info@carrisforcongress.com! **Meet Our Interns!** **Join Team Carris** We need your help! Join our team to make a difference by attending events, connecting with neighbors and constituents around the District, and sharing information with your network. [Click Here to Sign Up to Volunteer](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-v/) **Request a Yard Sign**
Spread the word about Team Carris in your neighborhood! If you would like one of our team members to drop of a sign(s), please fill out the form below by clicking the button! [Click Here to Request a Sign](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-e/) **Follow Carris for Congress on Social Media** Do you want to stay in touch and follow Jim throughout the 10th District? Make sure to follow us on social media to learn about Jim's platform and to get to know the District through his experience meeting local residents, supporting small businesses and local organizations, and learning about how #IL10 families really want their representative to vote in Washington. [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-s/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-g/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-w/)
**Share with Your Friends!**
You can download the Social Media Toolkit below to share your support with your network on your favorite social media channels. Create a post today and don't forget to tag us and use #carrisforcongress. [Click Here to Download](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-yd/) **We Need Your Help - Donate Today** [Every Donation Counts!](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eudhuul-tlidtddjku-yh/) | Paid for by Carris for Congress . . ## Senate Hearings Probe Trump Attack Failures
Top officials with the U.S. Secret Service and FBI [testified before two Senate committees](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSrCAQheGnwQwLGtSbENzEbDbd0EJpxt5CsKBHa99-azbe6ARfcur_fCwPT4ny88Mf6DiWxW9MFy6TNFqCXWwXXEQENB06PQFYY8w_6HY3ooqwjnZaIYRJwxC81SFYHMCHMKqOHCiwajJaK6Wt7jHqYTNxHJUaAm4grMJAXGr_VSjzjjF9lwtrv5WjS25nPpsw_wXMAub7vvttbRnv9nYBc6IL5esMnrEJmLm-jlO2vRSm_JQ7-vreuJJsuFVk2bBetKH0rfnWKHumkqVnxuN8a_aMAuauunDelBK1cRJWPQ9P6fcT_13ocvATAAD__xzKbEE) on Tuesday about the security failures that led to the attempted assassination of former President Trump at a Pennsylvania rally. Acting Secret Service Director Ronald Rowe admitted [he was "ashamed" of the agency's](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAURuGngc0RXDAkA0MXb-na0aLwO1BhEwFy1Lev2rnzkc7wfdzXu88lH493v8ONra4-jHxitZOSE-lV8-g2gKA4nLREWil1JZ6clvIWPm2IUc0gc9tU1AZaWSOus_WGZ0eCtLBKSiGklhdscg5qM0aIOSIQ0wIxj9ouXzUfI2Er3_VEu4S68-LSGM_O1BujhdEyElIu5bcxWlLdceDVGS0dhx9gtOirkDSrqSM0jKmjnTlgirkhjNom35PfERktvLn4fOVScjeWafHYff478_G_wenoJwAA__9kh13h) planning and cited communication breakdowns between the Secret Service and local law enforcement as a key issue. [FBI Deputy Director](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8Gb1iPBw7uwNDFW7p2tAg8GypsLCC28vdVOne-VzpH5_s-321McV-_7EamLXm2rsWTZs2l4Khm1XmzECHJjozQiEpKOWIXDNnBOe1AaBw-BjlaZ70bHghWAHgaumgQUIGWQgAIJXpaxODkcrsBDJ4cMgXkY8ul_8lxb4GW9Monld7lrUsmtHZUJj8ZTgyn67r6I6fYosvvA8MpxZP48_C2UWU4vWkMJ9AMJwkMJ5f3tVB9b8FeiV68kivUeKVyRkc8kPXcJVsDr7TbRvzxbIkKb-W5HbyGnFvcVw4gtBjV2BXjjyumFOtNMwXrZmP6s23_tzsN_gYAAP__sL1xYw) Paul Abbate revealed they discovered a social media account possibly belonging to the shooter with extreme comments, including antisemitic and anti-immigration themes.
## Park Fire Now California's Fifth Largest
Fire officials on Tuesday said the Park Fire had grown to more than 383,000 acres, about 600 square miles, making it California's fifth-largest wildfire in history. [See video of the fire here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzGPtCAUAH8NdGseD0QtKL7Gbr_2SsPCQ7lDMUog9-8ve_V1k0wyyXw8l6eNKR7rf7uTKSEv1pVYaRkeUjxQLYp7E4iQJCcjBkQlpRyRb0aHUfjej6DBiqA1TpMaFYCA3svgJx4NAioYpBAAQomOguidDFoD9J4cMgXkY8lX95njUTYK6TtXujqXd57MVsp5M_mP4cxwbq11r5d7O4bzQe1mONfoKb_B0VXb-oXnUTO_jD9bTCneemAK1t3G9Nssfx9Wgz8BAAD__1roUjs). The blaze is actively burning [across four counties](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL3O3CAQAJ8Gd2vBwvmnoEjj7tKmtDAs5004OAE5K3n66FJ_3UjTjObHfb87Tpwf392TbI9ld77zm_YZtAI0uxmCjURIeiCrZkSjtV5wOK3UXq7Tsh7TcahVT-TXYJzCoPwyL1EPbFGikbNWSkpl1EhR3byO0yTlLZBHYSQF7qWOPwvnflJMf8qb6ujLc0j27P3VhP4mcBO4Xdc1-qNlutrHC9w-KHDzLnEsNbODl6u_IHIlKJmgRGjddWqQXH1Q61AyVPKlBjh-19zAVXJwuhSh8V-CepZAwC25HARuQ7XhdXFK3KZZGPl4Ok7_2_rXp94W_wUAAP__tmFtpA) and is only 14% contained. To date, 165 structures have been destroyed, with more than 4,200 additional buildings still at risk. Fortunately, no fatalities among civilians or firefighters have been reported. On Monday, a suspect [appeared in court](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7tuhDAQAL_G7g6t18urcJGG7tKmRGZZDkcGI2OB8vfRpU430kgjzddzfPoQw_769Ju4sqTRcwmXjO3DmgfSSHp2iwiK1eJMi0jW2g716nrbsgHuJiAmML3tOu8tGG5qIjSTDg4BCVprDIAhU8liarZL0wDUszAqAplDSbn6TmEvqyzxJ12SK06bjm4t5TiV_VA4KBzu-66mid9O4bDLfSocfC6Bo7yRmwO3nKnf9qSzm487xBjOplUEr82H-Fct_z9eDn8DAAD__8zsUkI) and was charged with arson for allegedly starting the Park Fire. The individual is accused of pushing a burning car into a ravine, which ignited the massive blaze.
## Top 10 Best and Worst States to Retire
Delaware has ranked as [the best state](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOtCAURp8GOgxcGMGC4m_s5m-3NAqXkQ3KRO5q9u03br3dl3zJOTkfz-k555L31_95Q0-pTnOgfOJkhVYCzGR49AkRUHP0ygIYrbUDvvrkhjCg1i4mLY2CBZwDDIuDAXqrIs8eJBhptVJSKqM6TOoRdOp7KR8RAzAjMWaqR_dZ804rpvJdTzy6UDde_Er0bkz_YzAyGK_r6sK-hPtkMN5oBqO093YMxgUbia8mGs2ETVAVB1I-sFtpK_zw8X3lUnLrLTPytc25_Gro7-jTw08AAAD__2AKV0M) to retire, thanks to its tax benefits and overall well-being, while Alaska has ranked as the worst due to harsh weather and high living costs, according to Bankrate's 2024 study. The study [evaluated all 50 states](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQxvGnwRvW3UHsdGDo4i1dO1oOHDEVNhFcY_XtK3fu_JO-T__P23xbUk7742PZ2Eks8-IlvXgetUFNdrZdcJGZ2HTscCSyxpgrdau7-4uNQ4gmokX_hoHsSAyMVwKLi--SIyALo0EEQIs9R7x4E4cB4BLYk7LAIUmp_VdJu6wc8095ce192brsVpFnU-Zd0aRoOo6j9_vdn6hoOqcVTTAqmgycXmoT3WQRblqKriypsk67lpX1d-tX2XJXXXgeKefUhlFZeGxLyn938n_8y9FvAAAA__93UFp_) based on affordability, well-being, healthcare quality, cost, weather, and crime. Despite being known as a retirement destination, Florida only placed eighth on the best list, while states like New York, Washington, and California ranked poorly due to affordability issues. Surprisingly, Iowa dropped from the best state to retire to ninth place this year due to rising living costs, and even Colorado and North Dakota ranked in the top 10 worst states for retirement.

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/31/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey folks,
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, July 31, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Firearms merchants, tax credit for college, water conservation, wolverines among new laws set to begin Aug. 7](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_More than 200 new Colorado laws will take effect on Aug. 7. Colorado Politics takes a quick rundown of some of the more interesting and significant pieces of legislation signed into law by Gov. Jared Polis and set to hit the books in just a few days[HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or read RMV's summary below:_
* [HB24-1340](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): Colorado Promise Act - Establishes a refundable income tax credit for families earning under $90,000 to cover two years of higher education, enhancing connections between apprenticeship programs and educational institutions.
* [HB24-1175](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): Local Governments Rights to Property for Affordable Housing - Grants local governments a right of first refusal to purchase multifamily rental properties until December 31, 2029, to promote affordable housing.
* [HB24-1103](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): Prohibiting Term ‘Excited Delirium’ - Bans the use of the term "excited delirium" in training and official reports for law enforcement and medical personnel, except to discuss its historical context.
* [HB24-1266](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): Local Government Utility Relocation in Right-of-Way - Sets procedures for local governments and large utility companies to coordinate on utility relocations due to road improvements, requiring early notification and collaboration.
* [HB24-1372](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): Regulating Law Enforcement Use of Prone Restraint - Defines prone restraint as a use of force and subjects officers to penalties for unlawful use or failure to intervene in such cases.
* [SB24-005](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): Prohibit Landscaping Practices for Water Conservation - Prohibits certain landscaping practices like installing nonfunctional turf to conserve water, effective January 1, 2026.
* [SB24-066](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): Firearms Merchant Category Code - Mandates credit card companies to create a new merchant category code specifically for firearm and ammunition sales to track these transactions better.
* [SB24-079](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): Motorcycle Lane Filtering & Passing - Allows motorcyclists to pass stopped vehicles in the same lane under specific conditions until the law's repeal on September 1, 2027, subject to safety analysis by the Colorado Department of Transportation.
* [SB24-171](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): Restoration of Wolverines - Permits the reintroduction of North American wolverines in Colorado and mandates the creation of compensation rules for livestock losses caused by wolverines.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Hundreds of teaching positions unfilled statewide despite $10k state stipend](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* School districts across Colorado are struggling to fill hundreds of open teaching positions as a new school year approaches, exacerbated by an ongoing statewide teacher shortage.
* The State of Colorado offers up to $10,000 for individuals who train to become teachers and commit to teaching for three years in areas with acute teacher shortages, many of which are in rural communities.
* Denver Public Schools currently has 90 open teaching positions and is hosting job fairs to recruit teachers, showing a slight improvement in filling vacancies compared to previous years.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**['Embarrassing to watch': Rep. Boebert rips 'infighting,' calls on Dave Williams to support GOP candidates or be removed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Boebert highlighted the ongoing public infighting and dysfunction within the Colorado Republican Party, describing it as embarrassing and detrimental to their chances in the upcoming November elections.
* Despite the risk of disruption, Boebert pointed out that the leadership issues necessitate a possible change, especially with a key party meeting scheduled to consider Williams' removal just 100 days before the election.
* Boebert stated her readiness to support Republican candidates throughout Colorado, irrespective of personal disagreements, urging Williams to do the same to avoid leadership changes.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Police: Man pulls knife, another a hammer while one was collecting ballot signatures in west Colorado Springs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS 11 KKTV](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A violent altercation erupted in a Colorado Springs business parking lot between a man collecting ballot signatures and another individual, leading to both being arrested.

* The dispute escalated when the signature collector brandished a knife and was confronted by the other man, who armed himself with a hammer from his vehicle.

* Both individuals, identified as Simeon Prather and Terrence Woodson, were charged with menacing and are currently detained in El Paso County jail.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Substantial pay raises for county manager, attorney led to heated Elbert County town hall](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ELBERT COUNTY NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Elbert County Commissioners Town Hall became heated over issues such as substantial pay raises for certain government executives, with residents expressing strong disapproval and the atmosphere turning confrontational.
* Commissioner Chris Richardson attempted to justify the pay increases by citing the need to address pay disparities and stabilize the Human Resources department but faced significant backlash from attendees, who questioned the necessity and fairness of the hikes.
* The discussion extended beyond pay issues to concerns over county management and other local challenges, with some citizens demanding greater accountability and suggesting that funds could be better allocated to essential services like road maintenance and public safety.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[City of Boulder sues FAA over 2040 airport closure dispute, claims ‘unconstitutional overreach’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BOULDER REPORTING LAB](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The City of Boulder has sued the FAA, challenging the federal agency's demand that Boulder Municipal Airport remain operational indefinitely, which the city claims violates the U.S. Constitution.
* Boulder argues that the FAA's insistence on perpetual operation based on grants accepted in 1959 and 1977 for land purchases is an unconstitutional overreach, as these grants were meant to impose obligations only for 20 years.
* The city seeks a court ruling to confirm it can close the airport by 2040 and a broader decision that the FAA's policy on indefinite use of land from federal grants is unconstitutional, also requesting the FAA cover legal fees.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Sloan: With Biden out and Harris in, don’t toll the victory bell just yet](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_In the pantheon of political events, Joe Biden’s belated decision to become the first sitting President since Lyndon B. Johnson to not seek re-election was about as surprising as the advent of the sunrise at dawn._
_Even had George Clooney not bestowed the nation with the gravitas of his august thoughts on the matter, the weight of internal opposition – not to mention the polling that was looking increasingly grim for the aging and often bewildered President – was such that the decision was destined to be made sooner than later._
_It’s telling, somewhat, that Biden refused to proffer any explanation for his withdrawal during his Oval Office address. The exact circumstances surrounding his acceptance of the ultimate decision – especially given the level of resistance he offered up until the bitter end – are no doubt fascinating as political intrigue, and interesting in the historical sense; but as a practical and political matter, probably not all that important._ __**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[‘We must protect our kids’: Lundberg calls for ‘all hands on deck’ to help get initiatives to the ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 29** []() _The final days are winding down in an effort by Protect Kids Colorado to collect the signatures needed to get two initiatives on the fall ballot, former Sen. Kevin Lundberg wrote Monday in an email newsletter_
**_[House District 22 is now a three-candidate race in El Paso County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 29** _A third candidate has joined the field in the Colorado House District 22 general election race. The signature petition of Daniel Campaña was certified last week by the secretary of state’s office. He submitted 1,253 signatures, of which 1,056 were accepted to clear the minimum requirement of 1,000 valid signatures_
__
**[‘We are in crisis mode’: After meeting is blocked, Republicans further discuss removal of chairman](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 28** _A who’s who of Colorado Republican Party leadership here Saturday was still unable to answer a pressing question: Are they a minority faction or a unified movement for change?_

name: The Texas Flyover
subject: Paxton Wins Massive Settlement, Texans Shine At Olympics, and a Rideshare Reunion
body:
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has secured a $1.4 billion settlement from Meta (Facebook's parent company) over allegations it used people's biometric data without permission.

| | |
---
| | |
# WEDNESDAY, JULY 31, 2024
---|---
**Good morning!** On this day in 1817, French pirate [Louis Michel Aury](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOhCAUheGngU4Dl7sCBcU2drPtlgbhqiQoEyU6vv1mpt_qq85J_t_H8PApp23-8Su5-prK4ENNJw26UbIBHJBHN4poJScnNQCCQav44gT4gB0JohGDtEaMQYKVsQvaYhcjTw4EoNBKSvHVgWilIYxGR4vKjHryDAXFVMve1oUqvfwx5buctLehrDy7pdbnwdQ3g55Bf11XW4_Fly2njdqyzwz6z6qJ_m7G-w2Dnra6vzWK7y4-r5RzOjrNUMyrT_nzXf9JPR38BQAA__9XllZe) resigned his Mexican commission to rule Galveston Island after his government was overtaken by another pirate, the infamous Jean Lafitte. Today, we're covering two old friends who reunited in a rideshare and four Texas athletes whose dazzling Olympic performances have helped Team USA earn multiple medals in gymnastics and swimming. Yesterday's history item neglected to clarify that the Houston Texans team that Warren McVea played for was affiliated with the World Football League and is not related to the current NFL team with the same name. We apologize for the confusion. We want to hear from you! Hit reply to let us know what you think about _The Texas Flyover_.

* * *
Abilene ☀️ 104/75° | Amarillo 🌤️ 104/75° | Austin ⛅ 96/75° | Brownsville ⛅ 94/78° | Corpus Christi ☀️ 92/79° | DFW ⛅ 98/75° | El Paso ⛅ 101/78° | Houston 🌤️ 94/77° | Lubbock 🌤️ 104/76° | San Antonio ⛅ 96/75° | Texarkana ☀️ 97/76°

|
---
## Texas AG Wins Record Settlement with Meta
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has secured a [$1.4 billion settlement from Meta](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1u7CAUhJ8Gd1hwYMEuKG7jbm-b0uLneBcFg2WIvXn7yFulSTejTzMazcd9vtuYYn78tyua9lrKbH2LB86aCk5BzrILxrEw8g4N1wASBjmK7mm4EEoq7by2OCrumQfBPXLpBrWEhXXRAAPJtOCc3RSwng8ow6DDKMXg9GKJZBhiK3vfntjwZeuSvsuBe-_L2iXzbG2rRPwjMBGYzvPss_MZz3pxApP7qjFjrb8kvTCB6d1G7YOeMVfKtxJzk9TFlGLJtGJrCVfMjS7Woyvlk252v_yKzdLdZ8uVhNut203YzitWlSaSPVYb03te--Otw8BPAAAA___iA29G) (Facebook's parent company) over allegations it used people's biometric data without permission. It's the largest settlement secured by a single state against a business. The lawsuit filed in 2022 claimed that [Facebook's "tag" feature](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OszAQRZ8GOkf-mWBcuPiadPnaLdFgXxJLBiIYkeTtV0m_5dXVkY7Oz3W4cqlluf3nGVFe0zpwknJg8MoZZWmgNsdR52BaROOtJdtTcO09ns8Tjx6ZbbAaMGn0nTE-kOsmMKe2RKstae-M0efO6pPpQbn3OZDrRz9xQxq5yLqd5A7Bi_epvtcD2ymtc1vjXeSxN-5fYy-NvfBjwXP_XJ-xSUkVjb18OcUi67bgrW5YsHFVM4TVDpGKGYsoh0w5JJccj4koEDvvDDj1HTkQ2i3mx7PUWvbON6RvM5f69ZA_shzR_gYAAP__D9JliQ), introduced in 2011, captured users' facial geometry without adequate disclosure, violating Texas state laws. Meta announced in 2021 that it was shutting down its [facial recognition system](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2S4yAQhJ8GZePiz0YKCC5Rtpde6BrDYFOFhArG1urtr7T5hl0dfN3fv6_7F-aS1-dfXMjzd6p3DJw_dHdgFGh7t0P0DxknNZBXTmurRzuZ4eXdOFkcr9eAaDROkzFhtFFNKaXkblYP2WuprXRGKXm9aXlRI9k4ujhZMz5cQmElxcy1XfhFTN_YUznqh9ol1GUo_sW8dWH-CD0LPe_7fmn0Zmr97IWemcJrraU-D6HncDyodQrvlvnMCzHCVpBTbUuHDQ9QFh5lhU7MheAHCAX3_s4MJxYShowFGoX6XDPnukJERjh_gHRgpNDz0Hzc9lxK7jcnrHwumMvPYv5F4Mfr_wEAAP__d4h1Nw) and deleting faceprints of over 1 billion people.
## Gulf Coast Insurance Rates Could Go Up
The Texas Windstorm Insurance Association, the state's insurer of last resort for homes and businesses on the Gulf Coast, reportedly plans to [increase rates by 10%](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAUAL8GNix4EAMDQ5ds6drRAvOcoGITAQnp31fN3v1OJ93XZbn4lNNx_fQ7uv7ayuLXnp64aCYFA7UoGl3g0QqKTmgABUZZSW8uCL6q7RQ419x6EUBrEGY2Yd5QWTnT5ICD4loKwU8z8EkYVNHoaJU0QW-eKI4x9VKnfsOOL9-2_FOeWKe17DS7W-_3RuQHgTOB8xhjOnC0gfj9BxA4vx2Wjvao_liR3WsJGXe2lkeOzIfy6OyKnY1SGzJhpTBa0-rifaScU5s1Ufy6-5Tfxf7PgKeD3wAAAP__6oteIA) during its next board meeting. If the nonprofit organization approves the rate hike, the average residential premium--currently $2,300--would increase by $230. The development follows reports that TWIA has received about 25,000 claims totaling more than $200 million for damages related to Hurricane Beryl, an amount that would wipe out [half of its catastrophe reserve](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPvCAUxD8Nds8A8hctKP5b2O21V5qnPFYSFA9YXb_9Zbe_aiaZzGTy-76Pd_TBb48vXMmUl4sjzsUfNGpoBEg1qsqaidteVGSEllLJTvVNtRhrpRJCzaLnwrW9clpbVK5Dx1si1JU3kkvFdSME_9dKXouOlO207VXTTdohU5ysLzHVZaFCL8wuXPGgVM9xrYJZStkza_4zOTA5nOdZr3l7Z0wOtMEzMzlsdL7l4z8T4Lf8TLjNBHNcd9wuyHhlmChdAU4fAswxF1gwOIgOfMkwY8FcUtwXgkSZ0kFMDpjgdhM_Xk-lSsbu767PrWaKP1b04fOy_AHtMPI3AAD__-eOcbc). State Rep. ## Casino Group Lobbies North Texas Officials

clean_body: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has secured a $1.4 billion settlement from Meta (Facebook's parent company) over allegations it used people's biometric data without permission. | | | | | | WEDNESDAY, JULY 31, 2024 ---|--- Good morning! On this day in 1817, French pirate resigned his Mexican commission to rule Galveston Island after his government was overtaken by another pirate, the infamous Jean Lafitte. Today, we're covering two old friends who reunited in a rideshare and four Texas athletes whose dazzling Olympic performances have helped Team USA earn multiple medals in gymnastics and swimming. [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PcAeQcXy5V-G_111TgsvhA~~/AARclAA~/RgRojLEsP0T9aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL3BhLWUtZG9tZW5pY2ktYmVoaW5kLXNjZW5lcy1rci8_~~ "Karl Rove Headshot ")

Friend,

I've had the privilege of working behind the scenes in some of the most pivotal political campaigns in recent history. Today, I am reaching out to you on behalf of **[Nella Domenici,](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PcAeQcXy5V-G_111TgsvhA~~/AARclAA~/RgRojLEsP0T9aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL3BhLWUtZG9tZW5pY2ktYmVoaW5kLXNjZW5lcy1rci8_~~)** who is running for the United States Senate to represent New Mexico.

**[Nella is a leader with a vision for a better America.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PcAeQcXy5V-G_111TgsvhA~~/AARclAA~/RgRojLEsP0T9aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL3BhLWUtZG9tZW5pY2ktYmVoaW5kLXNjZW5lcy1rci8_~~) **As a former business executive and the daughter of a long-term former U.S. Senator, Pete Domenici, she brings unparalleled experience and a deep commitment to serving the people of New Mexico.

A few months ago, I wrote in the _Wall Street Journal_ that New Mexico could be a "sleeper" race for Republicans, thanks to Joe Biden's and Martin Heinrich's restrictive approach to energy, inflation-increasing economic policies, and dangerous move to keep the border wide open. I think it's something we all need to be aware of.

subject: Brand-new kid's book "The 10 Commandments for Kids"
body:
Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.libertyledger._M3GOFNWGqPJxaAKlVug)
---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](http://trk.libertyledger.)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://trk.libertyledger.)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
This email is longer than usual, but I promise what you read here won’t be like anything else you see from anyone else emailing you today. **So before I ask you to[chip in your first donation before our critical end-of-month deadline at midnight TONIGHT,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/62540?refcode=em20240731-7214&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7214%2E614464%2EvYWNKs) will you please give me a moment to explain?**

How a candidate funds their campaign does more than just influence how they pay for staff, ads, and organizing. It has a direct impact on both our message and who we actually serve in office. **Any politician or pundit who tells you otherwise is lying — and I have the receipts.**
Despite virtually every member of Congress having campaigned on making life-saving drugs more accessible, politicians who take millions of dollars from Big Pharma are still telling us we have to accept a world where people die because they have to ration their medicine.
Then we have out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley, who have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.
They’re willing to lie, cheat, and steal from the American people to protect the corporate PACs and mega-donors who own them — and they’ll even raise their fist to look strong before they start running from threats to our democracy.
**We don’t need any more liars or frauds like Josh Hawley in Congress.** That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. It’s why I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs. **[And it’s why I'm asking you to add a donation of whatever you can toward our people-powered campaign before our next major end-of-month fundraising deadline at midnight tonight. Can I count on you to help us take this seat back for working people, Peter?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/62540?refcode=em20240731-7214&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7214%2E614464%2EvYWNKs)**

[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/62541?refcode=em20240731-7214&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=4&akid=7214%2E614464%2EvYWNKs) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/62541?refcode=em20240731-7214&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=5&akid=7214%2E614464%2EvYWNKs) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/62540?refcode=em20240731-7214&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7214%2E614464%2EvYWNKs)

Our mission of taking power back for everyday people has earned our movement national media attention. And our commitment to running this campaign the right way, without a cent from corporate PACs, has given us the ability to run the boldest campaign in Missouri history — taking on corrupt political elites like Hawley without hesitation about some mega-donor being upset.
More than just banning insider trading among members of Congress and their families — **I’m running to put them in jail if they steal from us.**
More than just breaking up Big Pharma — **I’m running to prosecute the insulin cartels who are killing people.**

Peter, We, the American people, as always, have to stand up for our democracy by voting in defense of democracy this fall. The responsibility is ours, and so is the power. We as regular American citizens have immense amounts of power. I trust that with all of us standing together, and putting every ounce of energy we have into this cause for the next few months, decency and grace will prevail over extremism and fury. **There’s no doubt that we are in what feels like an unprecedented moment — but each generation has been asked to defend our democracy before. This is now our time.** **The thing that keeps me hopeful and optimistic is understanding our nation's history. There have always been trying times, but when the people unite and work we always win, and democracy is always protected and enhanced.** From Valley Forge, to Gettysburg, to Seneca Falls, to Normandy, to Selma, to Stonewall, every generation of Americans is called upon to defend our democracy, and every generation of Americans has done so. Ours cannot be the first generation that fails to defend and enhance our democracy. So I’m asking you to work with us at the NDRC. If we stand together, if we work together, if we sacrifice together, if we commit ourselves to this cause, I know that we can be that next generation to make our democracy better, and make our nation more fair. The NDRC has a winning plan in place to help build a truly representative democracy — supporting outstanding candidates in key states, advocating for pro-democracy ballot measures, enhancing our partnerships, playing the long game with our 10 Year Plan, and more. So let’s work together and let’s continue the project of building a better nation. **It takes all of us. **[**The investment you make today will have an immediate impact in November and a lasting one for many years to come. clean_body: Each generation has been asked to defend our democracy before. | Peter, We, the American people, as always, have to stand up for our democracy by voting in defense of democracy this fall. The responsibility is ours, and so is the power. We as regular American citizens have immense amounts of power. I trust that with all of us standing together, and putting every ounce of energy we have into this cause for the next few months, decency and grace will prevail over extremism and fury. There’s no doubt that we are in what feels like an unprecedented moment — but each generation has been asked to defend our democracy before. This is now our time. The thing that keeps me hopeful and optimistic is understanding our nation's history. There have always been trying times, but when the people unite and work we always win, and democracy is always protected and enhanced. From Valley Forge, to Gettysburg, to Seneca Falls, to Normandy, to Selma, to Stonewall, every generation of Americans is called upon to defend our democracy, and every generation of Americans has done so. Ours cannot be the first generation that fails to defend and enhance our democracy. So I’m asking you to work with us at the NDRC. If we stand together, if we work together, if we sacrifice together, if we commit ourselves to this cause, I know that we can be that next generation to make our democracy better, and make our nation more fair. The NDRC has a winning plan in place to help build a truly representative democracy — supporting outstanding candidates in key states, advocating for pro-democracy ballot measures, enhancing our partnerships, playing the long game with our 10 Year Plan, and more. So let’s work together and let’s continue the project of building a better nation. # ▶️ Protecting Social Security: A Promise We Must Keep

Peter- did you know Social Security, a lifeline for so many, is currently under threat?
[**Please watch the video below to understand the urgent need to protect Social Security and the challenges facing those who depend on it:**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=7069e4c516&e=a2a46ff12c)

[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=16ce954e5f&e=a2a46ff12c)
| For many, Social Security is a critical support system that ensures dignity and security in our later years. Yet, it is in danger from those who seek to undermine its integrity.
Created during the Great Depression, it was designed to shield our elders from poverty and hardship and has since embodied our values of kindness and solidarity.
Today, some dismiss it as just another entitlement, neglecting the promise we’ve made to ourselves and future generations.
This isn’t just about policy—**it’s about upholding our shared commitment to those who rely on this essential program.**
We contribute to Social Security throughout our careers, trusting it will be there for us when we need it most.
[As your future congresswoman,](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=9b5a0afb49&e=a2a46ff12c) I am dedicated to [protecting and strengthening](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=668b42b3f0&e=a2a46ff12c) this vital program to ensure it remains a dependable support for all who depend on it.
**Your vote this November will be a vote to safeguard this promise and uphold our values.**
[**Peter - Join me in standing up for Social Security and ensuring it remains a strong support for everyone who relies on it. body:
As president of our local union, I led the strike.
_[Click here to stop receiving emails about Dan Osborn's campaign in Nebraska from us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89918551/488835766/1647001491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzgwMzVjNy0zYzRmLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OuZyyxrQVC2sJOfOLsRlt_M_jAAjhAIzWf06-jQhHBc=&emci=2e399fc7-c44e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=438035c7-3c4f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=19445147)_
Hey there,
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family.
When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after.
But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89918554/488835768/92586991?refcode=em20240731am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=438035c7-3c4f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzgwMzVjNy0zYzRmLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OuZyyxrQVC2sJOfOLsRlt_M_jAAjhAIzWf06-jQhHBc=)
It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89918555/488835795/92586991?refcode=em20240731am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=438035c7-3c4f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzgwMzVjNy0zYzRmLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OuZyyxrQVC2sJOfOLsRlt_M_jAAjhAIzWf06-jQhHBc=)
Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
**Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her.**
Three polls now show me neck-and-neck with Republican Deb Fischer, and in one poll, I am LEADING her by 2 points.
**I am ready to take on Republican Senator Deb Fischer just like I took on Kellogg’s. But I sure as hell am not going to take money from corporate PACs, so I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this Senate seat.**
**[Please, will you make a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate right now – whatever you can afford – to help me defeat Republican Deb Fischer and win this Senate seat in November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89918556/488835804/92586991?refcode=em20240731am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=438035c7-3c4f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzgwMzVjNy0zYzRmLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OuZyyxrQVC2sJOfOLsRlt_M_jAAjhAIzWf06-jQhHBc=)**

body:
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
#

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july24.aPNp_S&refcode=em240731-1-full&refcode2=2748.734936._fIJ6E&t=1&akid=2748%2E734936%2E_fIJ6E)
---
Hello, Peter. This is Ken Burns.
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
These were inflection points where we were forced to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
As Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It has never been more important that we come together to ensure that our republic endures for future generations.
To meet that challenge, we need leaders who understand how important our democracy is and what it truly means to serve. That's why I’m writing to you on behalf of Ruben Gallego. Ruben is the son of immigrant parents, the first in his family to go to college, a Marine veteran, and a father.
His opponent, Kari Lake, attacks our elections at every turn. She sows the very same discord that is tearing our country apart. She is dangerous. Where Ruben would unite us, Kari Lake seeks only division.
We need more people like Ruben serving our country, and it would mean the world to me if you could support his campaign.
[**Can you make a donation of $25 or whatever you can afford to Ruben’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona? This is a critical moment for our country, and I would not ask for your help if this were not so important.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july24.aPNp_S&refcode=em240731-1-full&t=2&akid=2748%2E734936%2E_fIJ6E)

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1712%2E135344%2EzG56XA)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240731-1-900k&t=2&akid=1712%2E135344%2EzG56XA)
---
Friends --
While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails before tonight's July fundraising deadline, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**
Donations this November – when we’re in the home stretch – are important. But donations now are even more important, because they allow us to map out a strategic plan and make decisions about when and how we reach voters.
[**That is why I would love it if you would consider donating $3 or whatever you can to my campaign before our July fundraising deadline ends tonight at midnight.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240731-1-900k&t=3&akid=1712%2E135344%2EzG56XA)**

clean_body: Friends -- While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails before tonight's July fundraising deadline, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success. The truth is, we all know America is going through something right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple: Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class. Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security. Like protecting our children from the things that are truly harming them. And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream. I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service. But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018. It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions. Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation. By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away. To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs. Donations this November – when we’re in the home stretch – are important. But donations now are even more important, because they allow us to map out a strategic plan and make decisions about when and how we reach voters. | | | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=bcc54cba030e43d18519c0e8418b2022&_e=yiiI2UuDp4VrfF6onyYY8rb5i7cV64toUq4NZ5vWETj2QgmLJpcas-SQaSuPIfUXqyB45PgzRWiHUFHDZAl3QecDiTNOtWC0SeIHViZNNHir9Gflg3ztsQczfAji7CttYSW1wGXrbnIN1fXKPFHoZea_duC8aXSsfko6tvVJyb1wx794HO304UKcxSqcwAnlM2Sb7zIBjYofZGH1pXTWwUvdMKxKjwCnLv7T2Zfx3lNeiFBY7LDJaOd6Wx8SbsLX1rvUwGwElKObhcTY2PNVSaaQ5SG_bg3eP7Llbe0pNKrVknBMcMC7jmrAjXNjCCE4wcMZ_rZiiaQL4FQJgll1MF1EI9CwGrAFkq44_AM6KHrF9qwrzi7qd9z9vd275hQ99hc8P3TU4urW_LwUO5TGeQ%3D%3D)
