[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=bcc54cba030e43d18519c0e8418b2022&_e=yiiI2UuDp4VrfF6onyYY8rb5i7cV64toUq4NZ5vWETj2QgmLJpcas-SQaSuPIfUXqyB45PgzRWiHUFHDZAl3QecDiTNOtWC0SeIHViZNNHir9Gflg3ztsQczfAji7CttYSW1wGXrbnIN1fXKPFHoZea_duC8aXSsfko6tvVJyb1wx794HO304UKcxSqcwAnlM2Sb7zIBjYofZGH1pXTWwUvdMKxKjwCnLv7T2Zfx3lNeiFBY7LDJaOd6Wx8SbsLXEY40kEMbopgSd5FXXvog_Rl6YrpL59sLAlwt8whr47AfJiQ6p4ycN-nG9t5zL9E8TMlKF9ikQQY1Nh8l5k2wCFP-CiXV3zD4tHJRNTz_W362HRQzMYJobZ1FoWU9izwXxwtBQaAFKxkVmoOVnVyzWA%3D%3D) Hello Friend, ____ Some people today would have you believe that our nation was founded on secular principles, insisting that "a great wall of separation between Church and State" has always been our guiding principle. They claim that the founders intended for Christianity to be completely absent from all forms of government.

These assertions are false, and I can prove it. In fact, I have demonstrated it in my book America Is a Christian Nation, using the words and actions of the founders themselves.

The truth is that, over time, secularists, humanists, and atheists have distorted our Constitution into something the founding fathers never intended.

I invite you to read _America Is a Christian Nation_ to understand how our country has shifted from its reliance on God to a rejection of God--and how we can return to those roots of dependence on Him.

It's a concise read, beautifully complemented by stunning patriotic photos that you'll be sure to enjoy.

To express our appreciation for any gift you can make to _Pathway to Victory_ today, we'd like to send you a copy of this book. I know you'll find it both informative and engaging.

You can receive your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ by making your matched donation here: [https://secure.ptv.org/america-is-a-christian-nation-generous-gift-1](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=bcc54cba030e43d18519c0e8418b2022&_e=yiiI2UuDp4VrfF6onyYY8rb5i7cV64toUq4NZ5vWETj2QgmLJpcas-SQaSuPIfUXqyB45PgzRWiHUFHDZAl3QecDiTNOtWC0SeIHViZNNHir9Gflg3ztsQczfAji7CttYSW1wGXrbnIN1fXKPFHoZea_duC8aXSsfko6tvVJyb1wx794HO304UKcxSqcwAnlM2Sb7zIBjYofZGH1pXTWwUvdMKxKjwCnLv7T2Zfx3lNeiFBY7LDJaOd6Wx8SbsLX55Nwh4j2Q5tV0u3_6XWOfNZXbe3JggCu5UHTi6xFWzZRZRyMIOZF-BQOOSxMHu24rZE4CTqLxYXS0QjfhlYv4xBpHU1gRpB2FL7ECOuDflNiH5TjHunCW39c8--YxInhrLE3u8qVq6pWm0Hzcw0sZA%3D%3D)

As believers, we need to do all we can to preserve America's unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. I hope you'll join me in this important work.

Thank you for your support of this ministry.

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
This movement's support is something I will never take for granted
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1262%2E791427%2Emk3ftN)

Friends -
If you were to ask me what the _worst part_ about running for Congress is, I'd say that it's the obscene amount of money it takes to build a successful campaign.
The truth is that I _hate_ how much money there is poisoning our political system.
I hate how super PACs and anonymous billionaires can spend unlimited amounts to influence our elections, and I hate how many of my colleagues in Congress are completely fine with our broken, corrupt system because it all serves to benefit them.
But I also understand that in order for our movement to be successful and win, we do need to have the resources required to stay competitive.
The reality is that — yes — we have to run TV ads, we have to open offices, we have to fund our organizing efforts on the ground, and so much more.
_But all that doesn't mean that we can't stick true to our values._
We've proven time and time again that running a winning campaign through small-dollar, grassroots contributions is not only possible, **it's an incredibly powerful way to demonstrate our movement's strength.**
So I have to ask. Tonight at midnight we're facing an important moment for our campaign — the final end-of-month deadline before our August 13 primary. And I'm really hoping that you can make your first contribution to stand with me before it ends.
What do you say?
**[Please add a contribution — $3 or any amount that works for you — before midnight tonight. ### ****The Supreme Court stands for Justice, not Politics****
---
In recent days, President Joe Biden has proposed upending the Supreme Court by imposing a legislated "ethics code" and a single term for justices.

Let’s be clear. The real reason for this sudden interest in the design of the Supreme Court is due to recent Court decisions, not the ethics exercised by justices. _The justices need to remain out of the political realm._

Our government has three equal but distinct branches, legislative, executive, and judicial. Each of the branches of government establish their rules and proceeds as prescribed in the Constitution. No one would accept either the president or a court dictating the internal procedures of the House or Senate --- and no one should.

_The three branches of government are to be equal, independent, and separate._ They are meant to be a check on the other co-equal branches of government.

Many Supreme Court decisions fall into the range of 7-2 to 9-0 opinions.

The recent Geraldine Tyler v. Hennepin County case is one example where a unanimous court held that an elderly property taxpayer was to be protected from an overreaching government taking her lifetime excess home equity in a delinquent property tax case.

As a nation, we all must protect the Supreme Court and other federal courts from changes made in haste. The Supreme Court is foundational to the country’s trust of government. None of us, in either party, will ever be completely satisfied with all the Court’s opinions. It was purposely designed to not be subject to the whims of the day.

_Cases should be decided based on the facts, the law, and the Constitution. Nothing more and nothing less._

If an attempt is made to alter the Supreme Court in the fashion suggested by President Biden, Minnesotans can rest knowing that I will be one of many members, likely from both parties, who votes NO on efforts to change the Constitution to pack the court. The Supreme Court is for Justice under the law – not for politics.

clean_body: | | **The Supreme Court stands for Justice, not Politics In recent days, President Joe Biden has proposed upending the Supreme Court by imposing a legislated "ethics code" and a single term for justices. Let’s be clear. The real reason for this sudden interest in the design of the Supreme Court is due to recent Court decisions, not the ethics exercised by justices. The justices need to remain out of the political realm. Our government has three equal but distinct branches, legislative, executive, and judicial. Each of the branches of government establish their rules and proceeds as prescribed in the Constitution. No one would accept either the president or a court dictating the internal procedures of the House or Senate --- and no one should. The three branches of government are to be equal, independent, and separate. They are meant to be a check on the other co-equal branches of government. Many Supreme Court decisions fall into the range of 7-2 to 9-0 opinions. The recent Geraldine Tyler v. Hennepin County case is one example where a unanimous court held that an elderly property taxpayer was to be protected from an overreaching government taking her lifetime excess home equity in a delinquent property tax case. | As a nation, we all must protect the Supreme Court and other federal courts from changes made in haste. The Supreme Court is foundational to the country’s trust of government. None of us, in either party, will ever be completely satisfied with all the Court’s opinions. It was purposely designed to not be subject to the whims of the day. Cases should be decided based on the facts, the law, and the Constitution. Nothing more and nothing less. If an attempt is made to alter the Supreme Court in the fashion suggested by President Biden, Minnesotans can rest knowing that I will be one of many members, likely from both parties, who votes NO on efforts to change the Constitution to pack the court. The Supreme Court is for Justice under the law – not for politics. MY EXPERIENCE as a District Court Judge, State Senator, State Representative, Hennepin County Commissioner, a veteran, and a small business owner gives me the skills and expertise to solve these problems. I’VE WON in both Hennepin and Anoka Counties and I’ve door-knocked over 100,000 doors in this district. I know** this district. | Please visit and follow us on social media to get involved and gather more information on my campaign. | Thank you, Minnesota, for entrusting me with the opportunity to serve you. | **_VICTORIOUS IN STATE SENATE PRIMARY ELECTION_** FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

PHOENIX, AZ, July 31 – State Senator Shawnna Bolick claims victory in Arizona’s Republican primary election for State Senate.

“I’m blown away by the selfless sacrifices and bold patriotism from all my supporters and volunteers,” Shawnna said. “Together, we delivered a strong message going into the upcoming November election to secure the State Senate seat for Legislative District 2. Our district demands the legislature do all we can to secure the border, protect school choice, safeguard our elections, and make our communities safer.”

Shawnna has dutifully served as a State Representative and now as a State Senator for the north Phoenix region, led the charge to end child sex trafficking, and demonstrated she has the tools to unify Republicans, attract Independents, win competitive races, and bring true Arizona grit to the table to get the job done.

Shawnna is a wife, mother, first-term State Senator, dedicated public servant, conservative fighter, and the Republican nominee for the State Senate for District 2. There are less than 100 days until the November 5th election. Voters can learn more about Shawnna and her campaign to be the check on Hobbs’ agenda at [www.bolickforarizona.com/](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=b8c5eec36c&e=a7ab36849c) to maintain the narrow Republican majority.

Logo

** Defend Colorado: Reject Jeff Crank's Extremism
------------------------------------------------------------

I'm in an all-out fight in Congressional District 5 against Project 2025 (https://democracyforward.org/the-peoples-guide-to-project-2025/) , a far-right initiative that threatens our community's fundamental rights and freedoms.

My opponent, Jeff Crank, proudly touts endorsements from the Family Policy Alliance (https://x.com/jeffcrank/status/1796982194788790419) and Speaker of the House Mike Johnson (https://x.com/jeffcrank/status/1767616351764443533) , supporting an agenda that starkly contrasts Colorado's inclusive values.
The image is a diagram highlighting the connections and endorsements surrounding Jeff Crank, a political figure. It shows that Jeff Crank is endorsed by several organizations, including: Family Policy Alliance - Founded by James Dobson's Focus on the Family and serves on the advisory board of Project 2025. Americans for Prosperity - Founded by David and Charles Koch. Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America - Also on the advisory board of Project 2025. Alliance Defending Freedom - Founded by James Dobson, who also founded Focus on the Family. Veterans for Trump - Founded by Michael Flynn. The diagram also connects Jeff Crank to Speaker Mike Johnson, who has endorsed him and is noted as a former lawyer for the Alliance Defending Freedom. The Heritage Foundation is identified as the author of Project 2025. The Educational Choice Alliance, represented by individuals like Aaron Salt and Al Loma, also supports Crank. The diagram visually illustrates the network of conservative and right-wing
organizations and figures supporting Jeff Crank's campaign.

Family Policy Alliance: Founded by James Dobson's Focus on the Family, FPA (https://familypolicyalliance.com/) is part of Project 2025's advisory board (https://www.project2025.org/about/advisory-board/) . They push policies that restrict LGBTQ+ rights and reproductive freedoms. Jeff Crank, endorsed as "one of us," aligns directly with their restrictive views.

Mike Johnson: As a former lawyer for the Alliance Defending Freedom (https://adflegal.org/article/what-you-may-not-know-how-adf-helped-overturn-roe-v-wade) and now Speaker of the House, Johnson’s endorsement of Crank underscores their shared commitment to conservative policies that limit personal freedoms and healthcare access.

Recently, Crank celebrated a Supreme Court decision (https://apnews.com/article/supreme-court-chevron-regulations-environment-5173bc83d3961a7aaabe415ceaf8d665) recasting the scope of the Chevron doctrine, a victory for Project 2025 that favors corporate interests over public welfare.

** What I Stand For
------------------------------------------------------------
* Reproductive Freedom: Unlike Crank and Project 2025, who seek to strip away healthcare rights, I fight for comprehensive care, ensuring everyone can make their own medical decisions without government interference.
* Equality and Inclusion: Project 2025 and Jeff Crank seek to roll back civil rights. I stand against discrimination, supporting LGBTQ+ rights and protecting all communities from bigotry.
* Environmental Stewardship: In contrast to Crank's policies that threaten our environment for corporate greed, I commit to protecting Colorado's natural beauty and promoting sustainable practices.
* Veterans' Rights: Project 2025's job cuts disproportionately impact veterans, who make up 30% of the federal workforce. I oppose these reckless cuts, honoring veterans' contributions.

Donate today (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/river-website-home?refcode=crank-endorsements&amount=100) to support my campaign and shared vision for a just, equitable, and inclusive Colorado. Your contribution is crucial in the fight against Project 2025's anti-democratic, regressive policies.

Thank you for your commitment and support.

With determination,

River

July 31, 2024
| | The so called “Citizens Not Politicians” Amendment Proposal on Re-Districting is nothing but a fraud on Ohioans. **Governor Mike DeWine should immediately call a special session of the Ohio General Assembly to place an honest proposal in front of Ohio voters.**
****
How is it fraudulent? Let’s start with its leadership. Retired Ohio Chief Justice Maureen
O’Connor was the longest serving woman elected statewide in Ohio history. Her tenure as a career politician included over twenty-one years on the Supreme Court of Ohio as both an associate and then chief justice. The endorsers of the amendment is a massive list of the left wing swamp! To say now that she speaks for citizens and not politicians is beyond belief.

Look for my full article on this matter soon, but as the deadline approaches, The Governor, the Speaker and the Statehouse need to act _**NOW!**_
_****_
**Call your State Rep and State Senator TODAY and demand action!**

---
|
---
**THE 2024 ELECTION**
This election on November 5th is critical for the future of our State and our Country. We have an opportunity to maintain control of our State Supreme Court and gain control of the US Senate. With an expected Trump Victory in Ohio, it is more important that ever to stay motivated, stay engaged, and work to get candidates down the ticket elected. It can ONLY be done if **REPUBLICANS VOTE**.

We cannot assume a TRUMP win means all our candidates win. It wont happen. Make the commitment to vote, make a commitment to make sure you friends and neighbors don't skip this election, and make a commitment to spread the word on candidates down the ballot, especially your local republican judges and these state wide candidates:

**STATE SUPREME COURT JUSTICES:**
**Joe Deters, Megan Shanahan, Dan Hawkins**
**UNITED STATES SENATE:** **Bernie Moreno**
****
****Next week, Bernie will be traveling state on a well publicized bus tour. In fact, Wednesday he will kick off the day at our Trump Victory Center at the Medina GOP HQ at 8:30 am. Look up to see if he will be at town near you and show up and see how you can help defeat Sherrod Brown.

The State Supreme Court Candidates have been all over the state and really need your help to inform people who they are and how they will secure our State Supreme court and keep it away from the liberal activist judges who's aim it is to dismantle our laws. We cannot have that.

Please join me in supporting these critical races.

|

body:

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=54bf120b371e4c72882116baf62fe5bb&_e=Wxd7BVFFfo6JjstAL9ar7iu52XRhOZcAXZ1VchXhj-DQdNo1TjPjYg-mx-GsvPQ5NvXGHvDbbS9F7GKwA_YFr4rJ8pqoDCK8WjYXQJ5xPHNv0NMP_eesp6Wkzi5dIwx6btnc-0TaoFmTIL52P24gtcLhdNZHB9UplOpiGbhjyZrUM0NRkUd37S7Q5o-SLJYhO0odyGFmhWdNAAJPAmEgD_3mxIpKB9XV5LiU6xQeky3ceQ7h7LhmyUQvGDL_IR525KZacaYZo4TQmMUZeiI0jg%3D%3D)

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=54bf120b371e4c72882116baf62fe5bb&_e=Wxd7BVFFfo6JjstAL9ar7iu52XRhOZcAXZ1VchXhj-DQdNo1TjPjYg-mx-GsvPQ5NvXGHvDbbS9F7GKwA_YFr4rJ8pqoDCK8WjYXQJ5xPHNv0NMP_eesp6Wkzi5dIwx6CA_Eu1_scTKWQ91SKmrv5dXY18_1FjDXM7nNcF8_yZpFjPWNYHH3Hls9k750BmevG0HDJFXFWYmMrD48wC0mLdtGq1d0xHshozMtv1G-qi1Z08IYpve3fGIQKrmEQ9oGi08LUawoGgKyx2p_ra3BAg%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, they censored my talk about censorship. It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission. They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. body:
| | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voice of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This segment focused on the craziest month in recent political memory – an attempt on Trump's life, Biden steps down, Kamala Harris ascends, and PA's own Gov. Josh Shapiro is being scouted for VP.

Election predictors, pollsters, and experts joined us to share their views and insights you want to know.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Top Election Predictor Dr. Allan Lichtman** contended that "a lot would have to go wrong" for Democrats to lose the presidency in 2024, and laid out the factors favoring a Kamala Harris victory in November. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0234d632f3&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Franklin & Marshall Pollster Berwood Yost** explained why Kamala Harris doesn't actually need Pennsylvania to win the presidency as previously thought, and that her path to electoral victory could look different than that of Joe Biden. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c0b67b8382&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Elections_
* As of July 2024, support for Donald Trump and Kamala Harris is evenly divided in Pennsylvania, **with Harris narrowly leading Trump 47% to 46%**. [[PA Pulse Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e5f22e77e3&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Sentiment_
* Of PA voters surveyed, **60% had a negative view of the state economy** , while 36% had a positive view. This fight is deeply personal. = | = Last year, my husband Jake and I were trying to become parents. When I was almost 20 weeks pregnant, we got the devastating news that we had lost our son. I needed immediate in-patient OB-GYN care, but doctors’ offices were overrun by patients traveling north from states with draconian restrictions on reproductive health care. I was unable to get a timely appointment and was forced to manage a stillbirth by myself. Ultimately, I was able to access the healthcare I needed, but too many women are being denied access to the critical reproductive and maternal care they deserve. Boeing whistleblower Ed Pierson made an explosive announcement yesterday during the National Whistleblower Day celebration at the United States Capitol:
Unnamed Boeing whistleblowers sent him documents providing evidence that Boeing received and acknowledged reports of critical failures with two planes prior to their crashes in 2018 and 2019, hid this information from prosecutors and federal officials during earlier plea negotiations, and falsely accused pilots of causing the accidents that claimed 346 lives.
Ed told me he decided to make the disclosure on live television, in front of members of Congress and the whistleblower community, to ensure the information would be heard...

subject: I’m so optimistic.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
I feel like I say this all of the time, but it remains true: This year’s elections are the most important in lifetimes, possibly ever.
We’ve been reminded of the importance many times this month—from hurricane recovery efforts here in Texas; to the extremes of the Republican National Convention, JD Vance, and Project 2025; to the excitement for Vice President Harris’ newly launched presidential campaign.
This month’s events have made some things even more clear: We simply have to defend this seat, win back the House, keep the Senate, and elect Vice President Harris as President of the United States. I am optimistic that we can make it all happen because I have seen what is possible when we fight for what we believe in.
#TeamLizzie will keep doing our part every day until November to win our race and support other candidates on the ballot—and that means reaching the goals we set, including our July goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240731?refcode=lpfe240731]
Every dollar we raise helps us make the case to people at home why I’m the right person for this job and why candidates like Colin Allred and Vice President Harris are the right people for the jobs they’re running for, too.
If these last few weeks have shown us anything, it is how important it is that we come together—across our community, our state, and our country—to do the work that needs to be done.
That’s why your support and generous contributions are so meaningful, and why I’m so grateful for all you’ve done and I know you will do between now and November. And if you can, I’d appreciate any amount you can contribute before our deadline tonight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240731?refcode=lpfe240731]
Together, we can do anything,

Though I have not made my decision yet, it is important to me that grassroots supporters -- like you, Peter -- have direct updates about the state of the race. **This campaign is about _you_. See this picture? That was the moment Joe Biden asked me to be his Vice President. It was perhaps one of the most memorable days of my life.
After this call, Joe and I got straight to work uniting our country. Since being sworn into office, we have worked every single day -- together -- to move America forward.
Joe’s and my partnership is something special. So you can trust me when I say: The selection of my running mate is not something that I am taking lightly. _It is an important choice._

Though I have not made my decision yet, it is important to me that grassroots supporters -- like you, Peter -- have direct updates about the state of the race. This campaign is about you. We are building a people-powered movement, and that foundational principle continues as we approach this next milestone. | | | See this picture? That was the moment Joe Biden asked me to be his Vice President. It was perhaps one of the most memorable days of my life. After this call, Joe and I got straight to work uniting our country. Since being sworn into office, we have worked every single day -- together -- to move America forward. Joe’s and my partnership is something special. So you can trust me when I say: The selection of my running mate is not something that I am taking lightly. It is an important choice. Once I make the call, my running mate and I will get right to work -- just as Joe and I did. We will tour across major battleground states and then attend our party’s Convention. As I know all too well, that is just the beginning. So, as I prepare to ask that same question to a new candidate that Joe asked me back in 2020, I want you to be a part of the moment, too. https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
Missouri is at a turning point. In just a few short months, voters will decide the direction of our state (and our country) for generations to come. What we do today will have an enormous impact years from now.
But that also means we have a huge opportunity in front of us—an opportunity to declare unequivocally what we stand for, and what we believe in. An opportunity to show up and seize this moment with hope and optimism, and to inspire countless others to join us.
To do this, we need to be fearless, courageous, and relentless. And we need every person who cares about freedom, prosperity, and the American dream to come together and fight for our future.
Why? Because freedom as we know it is absolutely on the line right now. The freedom to choose when and how to plan your family, and to keep extremist politicians out of your bedroom; the freedom to vote, to have your voice heard, and to participate in our democracy; and the freedom to have a fair shot at succeeding in an economy that isn’t stacked against us.
It is not an exaggeration to say that we can make the difference between victory or defeat at this crucial moment.
So I want to thank you in advance for supporting me as we work to flip this critical state senate seat red to blue. If you can contribute any amount, even just $15 (for SD15), before our end of month deadline tonight at midnight, we can end the dysfunction and division in Missouri and make this state a brighter place for everyone who calls it home: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=july-eom&amount=15]

Real Talk
I am running for Congress and have listened to and learned from Northern Michiganders and Yoopers for nearly three years.
It has emboldened me to be unafraid to show my colors and highlight real solutions—not rhetoric, no platitudes, just real solutions to serious problems.

When looking for genuine, authentic representation, the last thing you want is ambiguity. So let me be straight - my campaign is entirely grassroots-funded. We need to catch up to our end-of-the-month goal, and I have less than 12 hours to hit my mark.
If you're able, every dollar is helping me keep it real.

And so much more. Why? Because we need leaders who offer details, show voters their colors. Representation that dares to stand up, have conversations, and answer questions.
I spend my time with the issues and with the people.
No culture wars, no chaos, no drama.
We're raising grassroots funds without corporate PACs, dark money, or ultra-wealthy donors seeking political influence because, for the past 36 months, I've learned that people want independent problem-solvers beholden to no one except you, the people we strive to serve.
That's why I'm in this fight, for all of us. I can't thank you enough for supporting me on our journey.
Let's rise together.

body:
It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.| | | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=89cbfeabfe004750bad5f562e3091d5a&_e=WQtrWqTz6MpoaIDpdQmHV1T2UgmPig2iyxUVZSC_DrCVn3okIaxDGltCnylJo3Ws53ih7HKnTTNkVz31giWD0Pdb5CYbLE5VgT0JeANGk8CQw5SYSFyU95-CjClnZJqYaOq84WrV8FqNCfQUBmUevCKhKiz14qtZ872TM37IaZ_5twmrDibLsKILttNg7J-Tpd17HioVG6aRcmOAjFr__pCbqk1QfD6x8j_ki93fTvJZXK3B8cPdfFEqcV9HdhWHNzQ7fjIWULuTqmh16NGydg%3D%3D)

Peter, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=89cbfeabfe004750bad5f562e3091d5a&_e=WQtrWqTz6MpoaIDpdQmHV1T2UgmPig2iyxUVZSC_DrCVn3okIaxDGltCnylJo3Ws53ih7HKnTTNkVz31giWD0Pdb5CYbLE5VgT0JeANGk8CQw5SYSFyU95-CjClnZJqYzNWvzYxHFKgxoDbfRPbMWHZoqc44Jpnwl9Es6faQNMwIolc1kip8XzwuGM-ePZpFegbv5QGWvI06a1Ozh1e66P7nfetAX75azwjVxA8d0jd-MXJBaIk0tbsCTiNUBA09Jq680xagSP9WsxcZ-KI3qw%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=89cbfeabfe004750bad5f562e3091d5a&_e=WQtrWqTz6MpoaIDpdQmHV1T2UgmPig2iyxUVZSC_DrCVn3okIaxDGltCnylJo3Ws53ih7HKnTTNkVz31giWD0Pdb5CYbLE5VgT0JeANGk8CQw5SYSFyU95-CjClnZJqYGK2U2WTFQk7ut8c99DvFtJD77tdtneKhKHDMq5ZMdRZhcqGhiSxVGm5P2iJrks8wDMyfuF52dtNl07YfOqMEIIDLCX2V78y0VkQ-df9oyIqJqhnR3YtWr22JfrT33OK76pKdhI3Fr2wwOfn8nRKJYA%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=89cbfeabfe004750bad5f562e3091d5a&_e=WQtrWqTz6MpoaIDpdQmHV1T2UgmPig2iyxUVZSC_DrCVn3okIaxDGltCnylJo3Ws53ih7HKnTTNkVz31giWD0Pdb5CYbLE5VgT0JeANGk8CQw5SYSFyU95-CjClnZJqYZJ-PvOPRn6CPxczyytoz9O9WibsAIdg0x5znW_5_wRwf0VFOgoaXrxsD1_UuFxhJbXh2K6-HRR6Ypsr9TciZl90rPwNJqMPEDlwvPsuw0X8MKNZWn1ojC9CU0SmLbcZ5bgTt5MDpt0Z1dUVIHV6IEg%3D%3D)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

THEN: Over 40 years of failed economic policy drove manufacturing overseas and devastated communities like Lordstown, Ohio, and Johnstown, Pennsylvania.

We went from being the world’s largest exporter to the world’s largest importer of steel.

NOW: It’s time to make steel in the United States again. And we can do it better and cleaner than China.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, we can
create a future where:

* We implement the Green New Deal to completely transform our economy
and society to meet the climate crisis while guaranteeing a living
wage and health care for all.

* We reform our criminal justice system, end the war on drugs, eliminate
cash bail, and demilitarize our police forces. We must end our system
of mass incarceration that incarcerates more people than any other
country on Earth.

* We rid Congress of corporate influence, end Citizens United, move to
public financing, and end the takeover of our government by
corporations and billionaires.

* We end our endless wars abroad and demand a permanent ceasefire in
Gaza: Instead of spending trillions on endless wars overseas, we
should invest in supporting our veterans and programs here at home.

* We enact Medicare for All. Health care is a human right: Every person
in our country should be able to get the health care they need without
fear of huge medical bills.

But in order to fulfill our vision for the future, we have to keep up our
fight to transform the Democratic Party by supporting progressive
working-class candidates, including our Justice Democrats incumbents like
Rep. Cori Bush.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240731-1.WNzFaR&refcode=em20240731-35851&amount=5&t=1004&akid=35851%2E1203867%2E_cri7w ]If this is the future that you believe in and are willing to fight for,
make your first donation right now to support our work of making this
vision a reality.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240731-1.WNzFaR&refcode=em20240731-35851&amount=5&t=1005&akid=35851%2E1203867%2E_cri7w ]Fight For Our Future »

Right now there are twelve Justice Democrats in the halls of Congress
putting in the work to legislate on these crucial issues — but Rep. Jamaal
Bowman was defeated by an AIPAC-backed challenger in last month’s primary,
and the same thing could happen to Cori next Tuesday.

The stakes are high, Peter. We
each must show up and fight for solutions that match the scale of our many
crises. By pulling together and creating a multi-racial, working-class
movement for our future, we can address these crises head-on.

We’re in the existential fight for the soul of the Democratic Party. And
the fight is tough. We’re up against fake Democratic candidates
hand-picked by right-wing groups like AIPAC as well as the GOP
millionaires and corporate special interests who bankroll their campaigns.
But people will always be more powerful than those who want to stall our
progress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240731-1.WNzFaR&refcode=em20240731-35851&amount=5&t=1007&akid=35851%2E1203867%2E_cri7w ]Pitch in your first grassroots donation of $5 to help us protect our
progressive incumbents like Cori and continue to build our bloc in
Congress who will fight for our future.

Thank you for all that you’re doing in our fight for justice.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas

July 31, 2024
Kim Fiorella, a Greenwich resident and former State Representative has endorsed Dr. Michael Goldstein.

Ms. Fiorella was born in South Korea and knows what tyranny is because she is the granddaughter of a refugee of Communist North Korea. She graduated from Harvard with an Economics degree and worked at Salomon Brothers. She was also a reporter Far Eastern Economic Review and the Wall Street Journal in Hong Kong.

* Codifying _Roe v. Wade_ by passing the Women's Health Protection Act;

* Continuing the longest stretch of sub 4% unemployment in the last 60 years; and
* Protecting our democratic institutions and the right to vote.

Hey Peter, it’s Tara McGowan, the founder and publisher of COURIER.
July was historic. From the attempted assassination on former President Trump, to President Biden passing the torch, to Vice President Kamala Harris’ record-breaking fundraising and grassroots energy – this month has shown why it’s important for everyone, in every community, to have access to high-quality, factual journalism.
**But for many in the U.S., trustworthy news is hard to come by. And, when news is breaking fast, that’s when misinformation is most likely to spread. That’s why we founded COURIER, Peter.**
[**We count on the support of folks like you to provide urgent election coverage in our eleven battleground states. Can you chip in $20 now to support our work before midnight?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89950377/488926885/-593472309?refcode=20240731-EM-EOM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGMzOWZmNGYtNWU0Zi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aZU-L65CsegsBO383zoD2q-T0NpPGHionX6lWYD5h6A=)

We witnessed this following the failed assassination attempt on Donald Trump, where bad actors quickly emerged to baselessly speculate about the shooter and his motives. Similarly, when Kamala Harris officially became the Democratic nominee, right-wing media and politicians perpetuated racist and sexist attacks against the Vice President. Some even questioned her eligibility to be President, echoing Donald Trump’s infamous “birther” attacks on President Obama.
**Here at COURIER, we cover the issues that matter most to our readers with honesty and fearlessness.** We publish our factual news online, where people are most likely to encounter misinformation, and stop it at the source.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89950379/488926887/-593472309?refcode=20240731-EM-EOM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGMzOWZmNGYtNWU0Zi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aZU-L65CsegsBO383zoD2q-T0NpPGHionX6lWYD5h6A=)

clean_body: July has shown the importance of free, factual news for all Hey Peter, it’s Tara McGowan, the founder and publisher of COURIER. July was historic. From the attempted assassination on former President Trump, to President Biden passing the torch, to Vice President Kamala Harris’ record-breaking fundraising and grassroots energy – this month has shown why it’s important for everyone, in every community, to have access to high-quality, factual journalism. But for many in the U.S., trustworthy news is hard to come by. And, when news is breaking fast, that’s when misinformation is most likely to spread. That’s why we founded COURIER, Peter. = In the immediate aftermath of major breaking news events, conspiracy theories and propaganda often spread rapidly. We witnessed this following the failed assassination attempt on Donald Trump, where bad actors quickly emerged to baselessly speculate about the shooter and his motives. Similarly, when Kamala Harris officially became the Democratic nominee, right-wing media and politicians perpetuated racist and sexist attacks against the Vice President. Some even questioned her eligibility to be President, echoing Donald Trump’s infamous “birther” attacks on President Obama. Here at COURIER, we cover the issues that matter most to our readers with honesty and fearlessness. We publish our factual news online, where people are most likely to encounter misinformation, and stop it at the source. So while Fox News and right-wing influencers spread bigotry about Vice President Harris, we made the facts clear about her legislative accomplishments and agenda: = We believe that every voter has the right to make an informed decision at the polls this year, and we’re dedicated to making that happen by providing rigorous, trustworthy journalism in the communities that will decide the 2024 election. = Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- Thank you so much, Tara McGowan Founder & Publisher COURIER Email us: mailto:info@couriernewsroom.com

They __ DON'T want to see their taxes go up while the top 1% gets a tax cut. They DON'T _ _ want to lose their Medicare and Social Security benefits.
And they DON'T want leaders who sow division and scapegoat others to stay in power.
But the Florida GOP has spent _years_ gerrymandering our state to ensure that they hold on to power in Tallahassee, while totally ignoring what the majority of Floridians actually want. _They convince us that our blue votes don't matter, to keep poll turnout low and voter disillusionment high._
**And then, the extremists who've gerrymandered their way into office pass more voter suppression bills, making it even harder for voters to cast their ballots with each election year.**
_Why?_
**Because Florida is NOT a red state. Now, friend, I need your help to prove it.**

ICYMI: Nancy Dahlstrom Speaks with Kodiak Daily Mirror

ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it, Lieutenant Governor Nancy
Dahlstrom made a campaign stop in Kodiak this week where she sat down
for an interview with the Kodiak Daily Mirror. During her interview,
she talked about a number of important issues facing Alaskans, her
congressional campaign to unseat Mary Peltola, and why she's endorsed
by President Trump.

When asked about her run for Congress and her priorities, Lt. Governor
Dahlstrom said, "I'm running to serve Alaskans and the first thing I
want to work on in DC is getting our border closed. We don't have any
national security with open borders, and once we have our border
closed, I strongly believe we need to revamp our immigration system. I
do not understand why it can take 10 years for somebody to legally come
into our country."

She went to say, "I think our economy needs to be fixed, and inflation.
I'd like to see interest rates come down on homes and we need to have
incentive programs where builders are out building homes and then
people can afford to buy those homes."

When asked about President Trump, Lt. Governor Dahlstrom said, "Well, I
do have an endorsement from him, which I'm happy about. I'll tell you
how I feel about him. He was fantastic for the state of Alaska. He
opened things up. He was going to allow the Keystone Pipeline. All
these other things that would have benefited Alaska and what I know for
a fact is that every time he talked to the governor, he said, 'What can
I do for Alaska?' I know he loves Alaska. He's familiar with what we
need. I feel confident that, should he be elected, that on day one he
will unleash our resources."

Dear Peter,
It’s time we heeded the wise words of George Washington, who warned against the perils of political parties.
President George Washington, after serving as the first Independent President, delivered a farewell address critiquing the formation of political parties.
Washington warned that political parties are characterized by **“...the alternate domination of one faction over another,”** giving rise to **“the spirit of revenge.”**
He advised that political parties could become engines that **“subvert the power of the people.”**
Today, we see the wisdom of Washington’s warnings.
The Democratic and Republican parties’ alternating domination has been sharpened by a spirit of revenge. Accusations and bitter recriminations have created a divide in American political life, perhaps second only to the Civil War.
This is why I have adopted as my campaign slogan, “People before Politics. Country before Party.”
It’s time we think about what’s good for the country, not our party. It’s time we prioritize the welfare of the people over momentary political advantage. It’s long past time we embrace ideas and principles that unite us rather than tear us apart.
**That’s what my Independent campaign for president is all about.** [If that resonates with you, then I ask for your support.](https://www.kennedy24.com/gw-wisdom?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eom_video_7_31_24_all_1&n=5)

name: Kerry McQuisten (Newsletter)
subject: From Convention to Wildfire
body:
| | |
---
| |
---
_**History in the making. Solomon by the rail to record President Trump's speech as David Bossie welcomes him to introduce Citizens United's documentary, **_**Trump's Rescue Mission: Saving America.**
---
---
_**We introduced m**y high school (and Army veteran) friend Debbie to former Speaker Newt Gingrich;** delegate and Marion County Chair Joel Pawloski to Sen. Mike Lee, and alt. delegate Sue Leslie from Clackamas County to Charlie Kirk. So much fun!**_
---
**From the Convention into the Fire ... Literally**
**PRESIDENTIAL POLITICS.**

Solomon has been to seven Republican National Conventions and tells me this year's in Milwaukee was the best! We rented a car and had an easy parking spot outside the security zone, so could come and go quickly. Our hotel was just 15 minutes away and an absolute steal. When you're navigating your way around thousands of other attendees and security teams from all over the U.S., the basics are blessings. Sessions didn't adjourn until 10 p.m. most nights.

We arrived the week prior for Solomon's final RNC meeting as an official member. Though President Trump trimmed the platform drastically, points number one and two (closed borders/deportation) on the 20-point summary sheet came from one of the resolutions Solomon authored and passed at the RNC. That's historic for Oregon.

In between the meeting and convention came the assassination attempt on President Trump in Pennsylvania. Like most of America, we were on pins and needles for a while. The last time I saw President Trump, I gave him a little hug in parting and told him to take care of himself. He said, "I will. I will." I'd been carrying around a weight the entire week before that attempt on his life, and once God carried him through that, the weight lifted.

The amount of time President Trump spent appearing at the convention was NOT typical for a nominee. He came out for the audience every day. I wondered how many took note. I hope attendees also noted those not invited to speak and not given certain access. President Trump is trying to unite the party behind a more Reaganesque brand of conservatism, an America First socioeconomic movement that takes the union stronghold back from the Democrats. The speaker lineup toward that goal was incredible. Solomon and I watched Hulk Hogan alongside one of my best friends from high school - I can't count how many WWF events she, my family, and I went to together back in the day! The entire suite of millionaire donors absolutely erupted when the Hulkster came on stage. Someone called it "joyful nostalgia." By contrast was the operatic closing with Nessun Dorma, which has always been my ringtone on Solomon's phone. Trump chooses this aria for a reason...

We spent much of our time following the Trump 47 Committee schedule, but that also meant I could access everything on the suite level of the arena. As for events - David Bossie put Solomon and me front and center with Jim Gosart from Republicans Overseas during the debut of his new [documentary](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/gNRn4NfIFX6dTxPrqgIC4A~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRojPf1P0UgYmRmZjgzODY1YjE0Y2JjODJmYmZhN2Q3OGRjM2Q3MTBEIWh0dHBzOi8vY2l0aXplbnN1bml0ZWRtb3ZpZXMuY29tL1cFc3BjZXVCCmah9XKqZhBLAqdSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAF9j). We knew Trump would introduce the film; it was his historic first public speaking event after the assassination attempt. We actually had to skip out early during a luncheon with JD Vance, as his boss "Trumped" him. ;) We then attended another event just before the final session when Trump accepted his nomination - with him and his VP appearing together.

Other random tidbits: *We successfully recruited for our Worldwide Freedom Initiative and our Oregon Conservative Caucus. *We ran into Gov. Kristi Noem as I was making a dash to the restroom. She hugged us again and introduced us to her husband. *We took a long elevator ride and tour of some back hallways with Speaker Mike Johnson. *Rep. Elise Stefanik sat at our table for a while and caught up on Oregon politics. *Newt Gingrich and his wife sat near us for Trump's entire acceptance speech - and he choked up when Trump said the exact sentence, which choked _me_ up. *We were stopped by the VP and Presidential motorcades and learned that each indeed does take a little over two minutes to pass. *We walked an average of five miles each day. *Last, Wisconsin frozen custard should be a staple in Oregon.

I learned of a death during the convention - a well-known member of the NFRW who suffered a stroke. (My condolences to her loved ones - I know some of them receive this newsletter.) During Trump's speech, one delegate had a heart attack and resisted going to the hospital because he didn't want to miss the big acceptance! Dr. Rob Steele, NCM from Michigan, treated him on the floor until the ambulance arrived. Another delegate was accidentally knocked to the floor with a possible concussion during the balloon drop. Quite a few attendees came back with bacterial pneumonia or the flu - not unexpected when you're exposed to 50,000 people.
---
| |
---
****_**The Kamiah, Idaho fire crew, my dad on the cat and my parents with Kamiah's Vince and Robert.**_
---
**A MILLION ACRES BURNED.**

What _was _unexpected was getting a call from my parents at the end of the convention that our family ranch was in the evacuation zone for the Durkee Fire - the largest megafire in the nation.

As always, the farmers and ranchers are on the scene first. Local RFPDs next. ODF after that. Then come the federal agencies. I ended up awake for about 26 hours straight trying to get back in time to be at least a little helpful. The fire came almost down to the doorsteps of both houses on the ranch, and the evacuation of my parents' home took the help of many friends and neighbors. Sheriff Travis Ash, Buzz Harper and the Keating RFPD, and Sean Lee with Baker Rural RFPD saved the houses that first night. The Kamiah, Idaho fire crew of two saved the houses the next night. My dad and Jed Polfer fought the fire back other days. We had no air support, and additional help was slow to trickle in. Trevor from USFS came in to set backburns, which absolutely helped. My mom had water and suppressant foam on the six-wheeler. Vivien and I just had shovels. Our neighbors were in the same boat. In the end we lost a lot of timber and pasture, the corrals, the barn, a bunkhouse, one historic homestead building, a chicken coop and miles of fence - but no lives were lost there and the houses stood. We count our blessings.

While we can't thank our firefighters enough, they're also expressing frustration with federal policies they say don't allow them to actually fight these fires the way they want or need. Wow, have they told me some stories! And of course, we know how badly our federal agencies manage federal lands pre-fire. On several areas of the ranch, we lost property because of those policies. Democrats have to get the boot from the White House in November before any of this will change. I have a wish list in my head for cabinet changes inside the Depts. of the Interior and Ag.

In the end, the fire came back on us probably five times before a downpour hit. For the next several weeks, everyone will be on the watch for sleepers. Then maybe eastern Oregon can relax again. Over 1,100,000 acres have burned in our state this month.

**OREGON CONSERVATIVE CAUCUS.**

clean_body: | | | | | History in the making. Solomon by the rail to record President Trump's speech as David Bossie welcomes him to introduce Citizens United's documentary, Trump's Rescue Mission: Saving America. We introduced my high school (and Army veteran) friend Debbie to former Speaker Newt Gingrich; delegate and Marion County Chair Joel Pawloski to Sen. Mike Lee, and alt. delegate Sue Leslie from Clackamas County to Charlie Kirk. So much fun! From the Convention into the Fire ... Literally PRESIDENTIAL POLITICS. Solomon has been to seven Republican National Conventions and tells me this year's in Milwaukee was the best! We rented a car and had an easy parking spot outside the security zone, so could come and go quickly. Our hotel was just 15 minutes away and an absolute steal. When you're navigating your way around thousands of other attendees and security teams from all over the U.S., the basics are blessings. Sessions didn't adjourn until 10 p.m. most nights. We arrived the week prior for Solomon's final RNC meeting as an official member. Though President Trump trimmed the platform drastically, points number one and two (closed borders/deportation) on the 20-point summary sheet came from one of the resolutions Solomon authored and passed at the RNC. That's historic for Oregon. In between the meeting and convention came the assassination attempt on President Trump in Pennsylvania. Like most of America, we were on pins and needles for a while. The last time I saw President Trump, I gave him a little hug in parting and told him to take care of himself. He said, "I will. I will." I'd been carrying around a weight the entire week before that attempt on his life, and once God carried him through that, the weight lifted. The amount of time President Trump spent appearing at the convention was NOT typical for a nominee. He came out for the audience every day. I wondered how many took note. I hope attendees also noted those not invited to speak and not given certain access. President Trump is trying to unite the party behind a more Reaganesque brand of conservatism, an America First socioeconomic movement that takes the union stronghold back from the Democrats. The speaker lineup toward that goal was incredible. Solomon and I watched Hulk Hogan alongside one of my best friends from high school - I can't count how many WWF events she, my family, and I went to together back in the day! The entire suite of millionaire donors absolutely erupted when the Hulkster came on stage. Someone called it "joyful nostalgia." By contrast was the operatic closing with Nessun Dorma, which has always been my ringtone on Solomon's phone. Trump chooses this aria for a reason... We spent much of our time following the Trump 47 Committee schedule, but that also meant I could access everything on the suite level of the arena. As for events - David Bossie put Solomon and me front and center with Jim Gosart from Republicans Overseas during the debut of his new . We knew Trump would introduce the film; it was his historic first public speaking event after the assassination attempt. We actually had to skip out early during a luncheon with JD Vance, as his boss "Trumped" him. ;) We then attended another event just before the final session when Trump accepted his nomination - with him and his VP appearing together. Other random tidbits: We successfully recruited for our Worldwide Freedom Initiative and our Oregon Conservative Caucus. We ran into Gov. Kristi Noem as I was making a dash to the restroom. She hugged us again and introduced us to her husband. We took a long elevator ride and tour of some back hallways with Speaker Mike Johnson. Rep. Elise Stefanik sat at our table for a while and caught up on Oregon politics. Newt Gingrich and his wife sat near us for Trump's entire acceptance speech - and he choked up when Trump said the exact sentence, which choked me up. We were stopped by the VP and Presidential motorcades and learned that each indeed does take a little over two minutes to pass. We walked an average of five miles each day. Last, Wisconsin frozen custard should be a staple in Oregon. I learned of a death during the convention - a well-known member of the NFRW who suffered a stroke. (My condolences to her loved ones - I know some of them receive this newsletter.) During Trump's speech, one delegate had a heart attack and resisted going to the hospital because he didn't want to miss the big acceptance! Dr. Rob Steele, NCM from Michigan, treated him on the floor until the ambulance arrived. Another delegate was accidentally knocked to the floor with a possible concussion during the balloon drop. Quite a few attendees came back with bacterial pneumonia or the flu - not unexpected when you're exposed to 50,000 people. | | **The Kamiah, Idaho fire crew, my dad on the cat and my parents with Kamiah's Vince and Robert. A MILLION ACRES BURNED. What was unexpected was getting a call from my parents at the end of the convention that our family ranch was in the evacuation zone for the Durkee Fire - the largest megafire in the nation. As always, the farmers and ranchers are on the scene first. Local RFPDs next. ODF after that. Then come the federal agencies. I ended up awake for about 26 hours straight trying to get back in time to be at least a little helpful. The fire came almost down to the doorsteps of both houses on the ranch, and the evacuation of my parents' home took the help of many friends and neighbors. Sheriff Travis Ash, Buzz Harper and the Keating RFPD, and Sean Lee with Baker Rural RFPD saved the houses that first night. The Kamiah, Idaho fire crew of two saved the houses the next night. My dad and Jed Polfer fought the fire back other days. We had no air support, and additional help was slow to trickle in. Trevor from USFS came in to set backburns, which absolutely helped. My mom had water and suppressant foam on the six-wheeler. Vivien and I just had shovels. Our neighbors were in the same boat. In the end we lost a lot of timber and pasture, the corrals, the barn, a bunkhouse, one historic homestead building, a chicken coop and miles of fence - but no lives were lost there and the houses stood. We count our blessings. While we can't thank our firefighters enough, they're also expressing frustration with federal policies they say don't allow them to actually fight these fires the way they want or need. Wow, have they told me some stories! And of course, we know how badly our federal agencies manage federal lands pre-fire. On several areas of the ranch, we lost property because of those policies. Democrats have to get the boot from the White House in November before any of this will change. I have a wish list in my head for cabinet changes inside the Depts. of the Interior and Ag. Recently, Joe Biden made the patriotic decision to put our democracy first and suspend his presidential campaign.
One thing is clear: Michigan is more important than ever to winning the White House this November. Our ever-so swingy swing state was the tipping point in 2016, the tipping point in 2020, and will likely be the deciding factor once again this November.
It’s no secret that this is a historic moment in our nation’s history and an inflection point in our race: Because the Senate race is the top of the ticket, our performance likely impacts the presidential and vice versa.
But I’ve won three tough elections, so I’m no stranger to responding to big moments in a campaign. In 2020, Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg passed away in September. In 2022, the Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_.
Both of these moments -- and the one we’re in now — had the potential to shift the future of our country. Our campaign will have to adapt, but that’s what we’re good at.
But we know that this news is also firing up the Republican base. And we need to not only match that enthusiasm but EXCEED it.
We have built a campaign that can win in November, but only with your continued support.

body:
Illegal immigrants are infiltrating US elections

|
---
Friend,

It’s no secret that the Biden-Harris Administration has allowed more illegal immigrants into our nation than any other presidency. **There have been over 15 million KNOWN illegal immigrants who have entered America since 2021,** and _there’s no way to monitor them once they cross our borders._

There is no regulation for illegal immigrants in Biden and Harris’s America.

**This reality results in increased crime rates, governmental benefits being granted to non-citizens while Americans struggle to make ends meet, and—worst of all—illegals who slip under the radar and vote in American elections.**
_We cannot jeopardize the integrity of our federal elections._ It is already illegal for non-citizens to vote in America, but the Biden-Harris Administration is doing nothing to safeguard our elections because they think they can use illegal votes for Democratic gain.

**It has been reported that when illegals sign up for government benefits, they are prompted to register to vote.**
This must be stopped. House Republicans are introducing the **Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act or the SAVE Act** as a solution. If this bill is passed, individuals must present a government-issued ID at the time of voter registration. The SAVE Act would ensure the integrity of our federal elections. It would protect the existing federal law that mandates American citizenship to vote in American elections. It would be a safeguard for our system against the millions of undocumented immigrants in our nation.

These are not just idle threats; they are preparing for another violent uprising.
Make no mistake, this is the language of an authoritarian takeover.
Trump, JD Vance, and my opponent Jim Jordan are set on dismantling our democratic institutions and replacing them with a Christian nationalist autocracy.
Our campaign has a great shot at removing from power a major player in Trump’s plan. Jim Jordan stands ready to deliver the Trump/Vance agenda, but with your contribution today, you’ll fuel a campaign that will kick him out of office. Now he speaks ominously about their secret plans.
The truth is that the ULTRA-MAGA crowd is emboldened, dangerous, and ready to incite violence to achieve their goals. They have done it before, and they will do it again.
We cannot sit idly by while they plot to overthrow our democracy.
Friends, this is the most important congressional race in the country. Jim Jordan is waiting in the wings to become Speaker of the House , and he has shown time and again that he is more than willing to facilitate this dangerous agenda.
We must act now to dismantle their power.
This isn’t just about winning an election; it’s about saving our democracy from a group determined to destroy it.
This is where you come in.
By contributing to our campaign, you are helping ensure we have the resources to fight back and protect our democratic values. Join us in this fight for the soul of our country.

Tamie Wilson

name: Dan Crenshaw
subject: Don't get discouraged
body:
Peter -

We are seeing it happen in real time.

The Democrat Machine - Nancy Pelosi, Barack Obama, Hollywood, the media - all coming together to turn Kamala Harris into something she is not.

Kamala Harris is not the product of the democratic process - she was crowned as the Democrat nominee without a single vote cast in the Democrat primary.

Kamala Harris is not a moderate - she wants to ban fracking, pass the Green New Deal, eliminate private health insurance, decriminalize illegal border crossings, abolish ICE, and strip funding from law enforcement. No amount of backtracking can erase Kamala Harris’s public statements.

Kamala Harris does not represent a brighter future for America - she represents the same failed policies of the Biden-Harris Administration that will make every problem we are experiencing now worse for America.

But the left and their allies in the media will stop at nothing to convince you otherwise for the next 97 days. They will try to memory-hole every damaging fact about Kamala Harris - that she is responsible for the border crisis, that she lied to America about Joe Biden’s decline, and that she would be the most radically liberal president in American history.

Now is not the time to get discouraged. Now is the time to lean in and give everything you’ve got to win.

We know the left will pour millions of dollars into Kamala Harris’s campaign and down ballot races from now until November.

We must match and exceed their resources, and that’s where committed patriots like you can help. Please, consider donating anything you can today.

[Even $20 will go a long way to help protect our Republican Majority in the House, take back the Senate, and win the messaging war that the left will wage for the next three months. When you donate to my campaign, your money goes directly to that effort - I do not hoard these resources in “some campaign war chest.” A dollar into my campaign is a dollar out to win the political fight ahead of us.](https://secure.winred.com/crenshawforcongress/e6406d849dfe8f71?utm_source=CFC&utm_campaign=20240731_dan-crenshaw_dont-get-discouraged&utm_medium=email&utm_content=hyperlink)

America cannot afford the complacency of conservatives like you. I need you in this fight with me if we want to win.

If you’re able to donate, you can do so at this link:

[DONATE NOW](https://secure.winred.com/crenshawforcongress/e6406d849dfe8f71?utm_source=CFC&utm_campaign=20240731_dan-crenshaw_dont-get-discouraged&utm_medium=email&utm_content=button)

Thank you for your continued support. Don't get discouraged. Get motivated to win.

In Service,

Dan Crenshaw

**This all began when** Texas lawmakers and Governor Greg Abbott passed an unconstitutional, discriminatory law allowing Texas police to arrest, jail, and deport migrants even **_suspected_** of crossing the border.
**Then,** the Biden administration sued to block the law from going into effect. The case made its way to the Supreme Court, where it was allowed to go into effect for just a few hours until being paused again by a federal court.
**...And now,** another decision is expected at any moment that could again allow SB4 to take effect in Texas while litigation plays out. We don’t know what the decision will be, but it’s critical that we start preparing.
If allowed to take effect, SB4 will open up Black and brown people and immigrants to racial profiling, discrimination, harassment, and danger. **We must continue to fight back to strike down SB4!**
Other states are watching this decision closely. Florida, Arizona, and Kansas are following Governor Abbott’s lead and trying to set up their own deportation machines. If the courts allow SB4 to go into effect, we’ll see similar laws passed all around the country. We **MUST** fight back now.
**This is an all-hands-on-deck moment.** We need the support of this grassroots team to help fuel our fight for immigrant justice and ensure our communities in Texas know their rights. We won’t stop fighting for a future where all are welcomed and free to live safely.

clean_body: The fight to defeat SB4 continues! | | | Peter, a decision on SB4 could come down any day now, and we need to be ready. | | This all began when Texas lawmakers and Governor Greg Abbott passed an unconstitutional, discriminatory law allowing Texas police to arrest, jail, and deport migrants even suspected of crossing the border. Then, the Biden administration sued to block the law from going into effect. The case made its way to the Supreme Court, where it was allowed to go into effect for just a few hours until being paused again by a federal court. ...And now, another decision is expected at any moment that could again allow SB4 to take effect in Texas while litigation plays out. We don’t know what the decision will be, but it’s critical that we start preparing. If allowed to take effect, SB4 will open up Black and brown people and immigrants to racial profiling, discrimination, harassment, and danger. We must continue to fight back to strike down SB4! Other states are watching this decision closely. Florida, Arizona, and Kansas are following Governor Abbott’s lead and trying to set up their own deportation machines. If the courts allow SB4 to go into effect, we’ll see similar laws passed all around the country. We MUST fight back now. This is an all-hands-on-deck moment. We need the support of this grassroots team to help fuel our fight for immigrant justice and ensure our communities in Texas know their rights. We won’t stop fighting for a future where all are welcomed and free to live safely. Pennsylvania state lawmakers had four years to change the law and allow pre-canvassing, but they didn't. The Democratic-led Pennsylvania House of Representatives passed a bill to begin pre-canvassing mail ballots seven days before Election Day (as was recommended by a bipartisan panel). But the Republican-controlled State Senate never brought it for a vote, with some Republicans arguing that the change wasn’t needed.
They don't see a need for change because they want you scared and distrustful, Team. RUSH $25 or more to help educate voters and protect the faith in mail-in ballots and our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=073124_2&amount=25]

WaPo: Pennsylvania presidential election results could again take days to count [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=073124_2&amount=25]
Team: Do you remember all the cries to "Stop the count!"?
When the polls closed on election night in 2020, one candidate appeared to be winning Pennsylvania. But over the next several days, as officials counted mail-in ballots, his lead shrunk and then disappeared. By Saturday, the other candidate was the clear winner of Pennsylvania — and with it, the presidency.
The protracted counting process left a days-long vacuum that was filled with demands to stop counting the ballots while one candidate was still ahead, declaring premature victory in Pennsylvania and building the false narrative that the mail-in votes were fraudulent .
Even if it was done correctly in the end, the delay was just another partisan tactic by opponents of voting rights in the state legislature to sow mistrust in our elections and an attempt to make sure untold numbers of legally cast ballots didn't count.
Why bring this up again? Because -- unlike the 27 states that allowed for "pre-canvassing", or the counting of mail-in ballots prior to Election Day, in 2020 and unlike the 16 states who have changed their laws since 2020 to allow for counting to begin, Pennsylvania is still one of the seven states that bars counting mail-in ballots until Election Day . This delay will likely cause confusion, deteriorate trust in the process, and make election workers targets for harassment. Again .
The continuing danger to mail-in voting is obvious, Team. Help defend mail-in ballots with $25 or whatever you can right now and make every vote count in this crucial election >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=073124_2&amount=25]

body:
Our democracy is under threat. Arizona is the front line of that fight. And I am going to do everything I can to make sure that pro-democracy candidates succeed — not only in my home state, but across the country.
#

Friends, it’s Mark.
It wouldn’t surprise me if some of you thought we’d take a break after our campaign in 2020.
Instead, we jumped right back into campaigning for a full term in the U.S. Senate in 2022.
We won in 2020. We won again in 2022. And going into 2024, we are not taking any time off.
Let me make this perfectly clear: I am not done. Not by a long shot.
Our democracy is under threat. Arizona is the front line of that fight. And I am going to do everything I can to make sure that pro-democracy candidates succeed — not only in my home state, but across the country.
I’m going to do everything I can to win this November.
We’re running an important fundraising drive right now, and our deadline is tonight. What we raise ahead of this deadline is going to determine what we can do to take back the House, hold the Senate, and defeat Trump.
A whole lot of people are going to be watching. Let’s show them what we can do.

Trump mentions why he endorsed Navy SEAL John McGuire over backstabbing trash talker Bob Good in the Republican primary for Congress VA 05.
Thank you for the shout out President Trump. I am honored to have your endorsement and can't wait to be a strong ally for you in Congress when you win the Presidency in November.
Since we won the June 18 primary, I've been campaigning non-stop around the district. But my former opponent Bob Good and a few of his supporters continue to demonstrate to everyone he is a sore loser by perpetuating false narratives about me with more of the same baseless lies that caused him to lose the primary. He is doing so via email, social media, and the radio. Bob Good is still trying to deceive voters with fake Trump/ Good signs.
I've always said he has a right to pay for the recount tomorrow so long as he follows the rules. I hope he will finally join the Republican team and realize it's not about him when we win again tomorrow.
It is time for us to all unite as a party and focus on helping President Trump retake the White House, win a majority in the Senate, and grow our majority in the House of Representatives.
We have a country to save. As your future Congressman, I will not tolerate past bullying behavior in the 5th. Instead, we will grow the party and unite to help Trump Save America!
