body:
Colleges are supposed to promote learning and dialogue. | | | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=1c26ff25f685432f9be8f26fa7e35d2d&_e=k3pLsI3063kiTzPJYLwZva0UfF9Oav2A5zj_Pv1cOe6GDg2-orOpxgxonh97tWsKn5oH_zc9o8ULMRfktn3cU44mWUQKR-VrsP_EoPOj5AkclxnWZnCrP4PmzVRq7u0DUxnTZycmFUe4RrUJ4bZJcPVLh_xcFu16DTqtWyno5-pzbxRVvwcLjtP1mHpmnN0hhYytHtmbAX6MzolvI0O_rDw1wYOYT0871eM8siIjOR9Q4k37sjqDk_XjfufA5JZXFIZqq4oVcLV4dwlDpmLZ6DkQUqsXxdm_NVWHea_9TxqW-IGoQLAMWtTQH_EKFAkZ7iQihcj14mQRHm_N1Tuju6P3RtC_N-TWwUIx5iC_43tnHyHL8QAQG9E3jtNC9smkO1F5-3rz1Wtc8_zOVN5TrA%3D%3D)
Fellow Patriot,

My name is Robert Spencer. I'm an author, speaker, and expert on global Jihad and Islamic terrorism, and I wanted you to know how pro-Hamas forces are taking over higher education.

Recently, the University of California in Los Angeles (UCLA) blocked me from speaking to their students about Hamas' reign of terror through a Young America's Foundation (YAF) lecture. Instead of supporting free speech and open dialogue, UCLA administrators sided with radical leftist agitators and canceled the event.

UCLA's reason? They said that the ongoing pro-Hamas leftist supporters on the university grounds posed a safety hazard to the students who wanted to host and attend the event.

UCLA should have upheld law and order by clearing the encampments and prosecuting all violators to the fullest extent of the law.

**Instead, they took every available action to block me from speaking and to prevent their conservative students from exercising their First Amendment rights to freedom of speech and assembly. **

The organization that invited me to speak - Young America's Foundation - is suing UCLA for this blatant violation of freedom of speech.
**[Give $50 right now to fight back and help sue UCLA!](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=1c26ff25f685432f9be8f26fa7e35d2d&_e=k3pLsI3063kiTzPJYLwZva0UfF9Oav2A5zj_Pv1cOe6GDg2-orOpxgxonh97tWsKn5oH_zc9o8ULMRfktn3cU44mWUQKR-VrsP_EoPOj5AkclxnWZnCrP4PmzVRq7u0DUxnTZycmFUe4RrUJ4bZJcPVLh_xcFu16DTqtWyno5-pzbxRVvwcLjtP1mHpmnN0hhYytHtmbAX6MzolvI0O_rDw1wYOYT0871eM8siIjOR9Q4k37sjqDk_XjfufA5JZXT0mt9qXiaky7MklCQZ3XP2_M1ujecZEanuUnQRCOLu7CbMgn6Hyba7fCEM6yj4yQINgtzzHB1kCbJIqfAbev_qYRvlkE4gK6eKgQpCNYpkRgbEhrkbSPpYo10yWluZhquzCuYltOj_SsRU6hvIm43Q%3D%3D)** Colleges are supposed to promote learning and dialogue, **not to provide sanctuary to radical agitators threatening Jewish students and Jihad on campus.** Yet, today, many have become sanctuaries for radical ideologies.

_All of this is having an effect on students ' opinions and attitudes today. _

Did you know that according to a recent NBC News poll, only 15% of young people ages 18-29 say their sympathies are with Israel, and nearly 1/3 of students say they sympathize with Palestinians?

In another poll, 20% of young Americans have a _positive_ view of Osama Bin Laden!

At UCLA (shortly before I was slated to deliver my speech there), pro-Hamas militants knocked a Jewish girl unconscious and stomped on her Israel flag. And there was no outrage over this by leftist administrators at the college.

Instead, a conservative coming to speak on campus is the UCLA administrators' greatest fear and the biggest security threat!

Enough is enough. We need your support to help YAF win this lawsuit against UCLA and help fight for students' free speech rights nationwide.

You may have heard of Young America's Foundation as the country's leading conservative youth organization for more than 60 years. YAF goes directly to high school and college campuses with the best speakers in the conservative movement, including **Ben Shapiro** , **Matt Walsh** , **Katie Pavlich** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , and many others so that students can freely express and engage with the values that make us free. YAF promotes your values, such as a strong national defense, individual freedom, limited government, and freedom of speech to large student audiences.

Young America's Foundation is taking a stand against UCLA's censorship of conservative free speech.

**YAF is suing UCLA and will take them to court so that students can hear the truth about Hamas --the truth that their school is fighting to keep from them. **

But they can't do this alone. UCLA has vast resources and teams of lawyers preparing to defend their excuse for shutting down a conservative lecture on campus.

**Will you give $50 right now to stand with the conservative students of UCLA and fight back?** We are looking for 76 Americans to step forward today with a gift to protect conservative free speech. **And** **every dollar you give will fuel our fight to ensure that students on EVERY campus can learn the truth about Israel, Hamas, and the freedoms that make America great. **

Here's the secure link where you can quickly make your gift: **[https://secure.yaf.org/ucla-lawsuit-protect-conservative-speech](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=1c26ff25f685432f9be8f26fa7e35d2d&_e=k3pLsI3063kiTzPJYLwZva0UfF9Oav2A5zj_Pv1cOe6GDg2-orOpxgxonh97tWsKn5oH_zc9o8ULMRfktn3cU44mWUQKR-VrsP_EoPOj5AkclxnWZnCrP4PmzVRq7u0DUxnTZycmFUe4RrUJ4bZJcPVLh_xcFu16DTqtWyno5-pzbxRVvwcLjtP1mHpmnN0hhYytHtmbAX6MzolvI0O_rDw1wYOYT0871eM8siIjOR9Q4k37sjqDk_XjfufA5JZXM4kwfmPN2ZErnnmylzy8juo6vmt6fq3gp01A8dAFXyeNYy8W2_LoY0Uvk6evLYB7Gia1B1HWdcqHM-mGwoPTso5o0iVnziif1a487FyIJ17kdZ7GGDG0dElrkfDy6htuRLv4k7l0zdlVyS95q94i6A%3D%3D)**

YAF does not play around when students' First Amendment rights are infringed. YAF sued the University of California at Berkeley, and won a major freedom of speech lawsuit!

But they need your support right away!

UCLA and every other leftist university are counting on conservatives like you sitting this fight out. Thank you for taking action right now and fighting back.

Sincerely,

Robert Spencer
**YAF Speaker, Bestselling Author**

#
Peter — **everyone is waiting for Josh Hawley to have a “Todd Akin moment,” but the truth is that he’s already had a whole career’s worth.**
Please let us explain.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/63072?refcode=em20240731-7220&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7220%2E614464%2E1_hGJG)
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/63072?refcode=em20240731-7220&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7220%2E614464%2E1_hGJG)**
Todd Akin was the GOP U.S. Senate candidate Missourians rejected by **_double digits**_ after he exposed his extreme anti-abortion beliefs.

Hello,
After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make.
When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits.
Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children.
After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last.
I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith.
Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this seat is going to be much harder to win. The Super PACs are attacking me and the smear campaign is beginning. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this critical House seat.
I made the decision to run again because I knew I could count on people like you to help me win, so it would mean so much to me if you could chip in to my campaign today:
[**Please, will you give $5 or more right now – whatever you can afford before midnight tonight – to help me hit our critical fundraising goal and win this critical House seat?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89959040/488955907/1610638071?refcode=em20240731mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=160593e5-6a4f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjA1OTNlNS02YTRmLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pwiaT__U8UgOm639gN46z6ZLyqKIk-5RaQ55L1oDN8E=)

Imagine a future where the Department of Education is eliminated, any discussion of racism is criminalized, public tax dollars fund private Christian instruction, and discrimination against LGBTQ Americans is legalized. That, in a nutshell, is what Project 2025 intends to do with education in America.
This article covers Project 2025's attacks on public education in America. In the Project 2025 fascist dystopia, every school is a religious institution teaching Christian nationalist theocracy, and secular education has no place. As a human rights lawyer, I am reading the entire 900 page Project 2025 fascist manifesto so you don't have to, and giving you the tools to debunk its claims. And as we dive into Project 2025's attacks on education, I cannot underestimate the threat to our children.
So, **Let 's Address This.**

A supporter holds a Project 2025 fan in the group's tent at the Iowa State Fair on Aug. 14, 2023. (Photo cred: Charlie Neibergall / Associated Press)
## P25 Mentions Education At Least 400 Times
The phrases "education" and "public schools" are referenced at least 400 times in the Project 2025 ("P25") manifesto. The P25 Forward sets the tone for how degradingly it treats public education as it argues for universal school choice, defunding any institution who oppose the P25 mandate, and leans firmly into the "CRT" boogey man:
> [u]niversal school choice [is] a goal all conservatives and conservative Presidents must pursue. But even before we achieve that long-term goal, parents' rights as their children's primary educators should be non-negotiable in American schools. States, cities and counties, school boards, union bosses, principals, and teachers who disagree should be immediately cut off from federal funds. The noxious tenets of "critical race theory" and "gender ideology" should be excised from curricula in every public school in the country. These theories poison our children, who are being taught on the one hand to affirm that the color of their skin fundamentally determines their identity...
## Playing Victim
P25 plays victim in claiming that parents no longer have any power over what their children learn, and therefore the next President should defund any public education institution who "denies parental rights." Except, none of this is true. Parents currently have and have always had total control over public school curriculum through locally elected school board members, on the state level through state legislators, and federally through U.S. Congress.
Likewise, critical race theory ("CRT") is not taught in public elementary, middle, or high school. P25 posits CRT as a boogey man to advance their fascist agenda.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f66f0c0b-8280-42ac-b70d-e318ce9171a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Finally, it's laughable when right wing pundits object to the idea that "skin color determines identity." The same group that claims "I don't see color" loudly objects to claims that "Black Lives Matter" and rebuts it with "Blue Lives Matter." The group that claims "color doesn't matter" is still condemning Usha Vance, the Indian American wife of VP Candidate JD Vance, [because of her skin color](https://substack.com/redirect/49e33023-02e8-42a3-adf1-542d1fd6273e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And beyond racist rhetoric, the group that claims "color doesn't matter," would have us ignore that Black women suffer a [300% higher maternal mortality rate than white mothers](https://substack.com/redirect/1465f651-6f22-4eb8-ba4a-287a47729ae8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), that Black and Indigenous children suffer a 300% higher infant mortality rate than white babies, that [police arrest Black and Latino Americans at 6-10x the rate of white Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/752274d7-54ca-4655-bb56-9ea51114ef8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite similar crime rates, and that [Black American wealth is still a fraction of the wealth of white Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/542e52bb-6cf8-4e0f-b782-f79bd7936272?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) even 60 years after the Civil Rights Acts were passed.
It is no surprise, therefore, that the first step P25 plans to take to enact its fascist decimation of public education is to dismantle the Department of Education.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ev_V6NaeMavU_LqSJFhpNG99s-GBur9ardOnVT3IpaU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147105093)
## P25 Plans To Eliminate The Dept of Education
On Page 285 Project 2025 authors make their intent clear--fully shut down the Department of Education:
> The Department of Education...is a convenient one-stop shop for the woke education cartel. This department is an example of federal intrusion into a traditionally state and local realm. For the sake of American children, Congress should shutter it and return control of education to the states.
In doing so, P25 seeks to undermine the number one reason Congress created The Department of Education in 1979, [namely](https://substack.com/redirect/88f411e3-a8fe-4b55-8236-4e607cd2ee33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "_to strengthen the Federal commitment to ensuring access to equal educational opportunity for every individual. "_ In a post Jim-Crow America, visionary leaders like Jimmy Carter saw that for too many young people, their zip code determined their education level and access. The Federal Department of Education sought to change that. Sadly, despite nearly half a century since the creation of the DOE, [zip codes still largely determine a child's education level and access](https://substack.com/redirect/b17f56a4-5de0-45de-b30d-3adde7a06dd7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
By eliminating Federal minimum standards, as P25 seeks to do, this will only get worse--particularly for children from Black, Latino, or low income backgrounds. With this premise of dismantling the DOE, the fascist P25 initiative goes on a rampage to decimate education in America as we now it.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ev_V6NaeMavU_LqSJFhpNG99s-GBur9ardOnVT3IpaU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147105093)
## P25 Decimates Education As We Know It
**Title I:** On Page 326, P25 calls to shift Title I funding for low income students to states entirely, and phase it out over a 10 year period. This would, of course, further devastate Black, Latino, and low income communities, especially considering majority white schools already receive [$23B more in annual funding](https://substack.com/redirect/105ea5c2-59c9-4a54-a2f9-b17b2053bc3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than majority Black or Latino schools. A recent report by EdBuild found [the difference in funding is](https://substack.com/redirect/105ea5c2-59c9-4a54-a2f9-b17b2053bc3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> $23 billion. According to EdBuild, that's how much _more_ funding predominantly white school districts receive compared with districts that serve mostly students of color. For every student enrolled, the average nonwhite school district receives $2,226 less than a white school district.
The P25 goal to eliminate Title I funding for low income schools will further exacerbate the racial and economic divide. That taxpayer funding, P25 argues, should go to parents to use on private (Christian) schools as they wish. The very idea of using taxpayer dollars for private religious instruction undermines the fabric of religion/state separation upon which this country has existed for nearly 250 years.
**Higher Education:** On Page 354, P25 calls for the elimination of ParentPlus loans and Federal Pell Grants, arguing there are "plenty of private options available." The P25 push to further privatize education is a naked attempt to drive a wedge between the haves and have nots.
**Head Start:** On page 485, P25 calls for the elimination of Head Start, which annually serves nearly 1 million low income children. Free school lunch? Forget about it.
**Legalizing Discrimination:** On page 584, P25 calls for the outright elimination of laws and regulations that ban discrimination of LGBTQ students and Americans. This is particularly destructive given the [history of anti-LGBTQ violence in America](https://substack.com/redirect/b42f09ee-20f4-484e-92aa-1fd32f2da0e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**Privatizing Loans:** Throughout the document, P25 calls for transferring all student loans and grants from federal to private entities, and then posits eliminating any attempts to cancel student loans for any reason whatsoever. And while P25 calls for a return of fraudulently taken PPP loans, it makes no similar demand to under PPP loan cancellation. Apparently P25 holds that the "pay back what you took out" rule only applies to struggling students under a mountain of exploitative predatory debt, not to major corporations and politicians who had billions in loans cancelled.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ev_V6NaeMavU_LqSJFhpNG99s-GBur9ardOnVT3IpaU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147105093)
## In Conclusion
P25 fears a public education system that calls for meaningful racial justice and accountability, one that holds a mirror up to the injustices of white supremacy, and one that demands equal access to education for children of all races and socio-economic classes. This horrifies the fascists behind P25 because, as the old saying goes, "_When you 've had privilege your whole life, equality feels like oppression_."
In fact, so fearful are P25 fascists of racial justice, that P25 not only bans teaching about DEI, it demands prosecution of universities and employers who enact DEI practices. Throughout the manifesto, P25 calls for a ban on any instruction that teaches about race or racism in the United States. In short, an education system under a Project 2025 administration would mean a gutting of public education, a transfer o wealth to predominantly white, predominately wealth families for private school vouchers, an advancement of Christian nationalist theocratic education, a ban on teachings of racial justice, a green light for even violent anti-LGBTQ discrimination, and an exacerbation of existing racial segregation and underfunding of majority Black and Latino institutions.
Therefore, it is absolutely critical we remain vigilant and engaged to ensure P25 does not become policy. It is not an exaggeration to say it is literally a matter of life and death for millions of people in America. You have my commitment to continue to publicize and expose P25's fascist policies, and arm you with the tools and knowledge to rebuke them. And I am grateful for your support to continue to advance this cause of human rights, accountability, and justice.

This morning I had the opportunity to speak at the Neshoba County Fair about our campaign’s vision for Mississippi, and our country. As a country, we have a responsibility to maintain and uphold our democracy. We have a responsibility to reject politicians who claim to defend our Constitution while standing with an insurrectionist. We have a responsibility to hold our leaders accountable at the ballot box when they fail to uphold their oaths.

We’re working to hold our opponent accountable this November. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Ilhan Omar is a fighter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
Ilhan knows her stuff, and we need her back in Congress. But that's not something any of us can do alone — and we don’t get what we don’t fight for.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1266%2E791427%2EDfddYh)

Team, it's Elizabeth Warren, reaching out to ask if you can **[split a contribution of $10 today to support my friend Ilhan Omar ahead of her important primary election in Minnesota next month, and help strengthen our progressive movement.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-july24-warren.YJ12wO&refcode=em240731-2&t=2&akid=1266%2E791427%2EDfddYh)**
Here's why I’m asking:
Throughout her first three terms in Congress, Ilhan has been a terrific progressive champion for Minnesota's 5th district and a leading voice for working families nationwide.
Ilhan has been a partner to me in Washington on a number of issues, and I can say with certainty that the very first thing people notice about Ilhan is that **she is a fighter.**
Ilhan's fighting for an economy that delivers for working families — not large financial institutions and the ultra-wealthy who can hire powerful Washington lobbyists and corporate lawyers.
Ilhan's fighting for an immigration system that prioritizes justice and humanity for people seeking a better life in the United States — not one centered on punishment and fear.
Ilhan's fighting for abortion rights and the freedom for women to control their own bodies — not right-wing politicians and Republican state legislatures.
Ilhan's fighting for canceling student loan debt, putting an end to a generational crisis that's holding back our economy and crushing millions of families nationwide — not loan providers and debt collectors preying on the hopes and dreams of young people.
Ilhan's fighting for Medicare for All, and a future where healthcare is seen as a basic human right and _nobody_ goes broke because of a medical bill — not the bottom-line of the insurance companies and Big Pharma.
Ilhan's fighting for a Green New Deal and combating the climate crisis through bold, aggressive action to save our planet — not fossil fuel giants and corporate polluters destroying it for profit.
**Ilhan's fighting hard each and every day for all of this and so much more, both at home in Minnesota and for working people across our country. And today she's counting on our progressive movement to stand with her in that fight.**
Throughout all of her campaigns for Congress, Ilhan's gone up against millions of dollars in outside super PAC spending and faced vicious, bigoted attacks from extremist Republicans. But time and time again, she has shown incredible resilience, out-working and out-organizing the powerful special interests who want to see her fail. That’s been possible because of the support from this team, and she needs our support again to keep fighting in Congress.
**[So Team, if you're able, can you please split a $10 contribution to support Ilhan, and our re-election campaign today? With just 13 days to go until primary day in Minnesota, anything you can chip in will help show that this grassroots movement is stronger than ever.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-july24-warren.YJ12wO&refcode=em240731-2&t=3&akid=1266%2E791427%2EDfddYh)**

| | | | Friends and Colleagues,

We partnered again with Ipsos and just completed a national poll that found that Americans ranked “honesty,” a trait often associated with military service, as the most appealing attribute for elected officials.

The poll also shows a strong preference for veterans as Democratic Vice Presidential candidates. Navy veteran and With Honor Senate affiliate Mark Kelly was tied at the top of the list with Governor Wes Moore, who is the first veteran With Honor’s political action committees supported for a gubernatorial race. Other principled veterans including [For Country Caucus](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=fa051a757a&e=33f53a5b1a) Co-Chair Rep. Jason Crow and For Country Caucus Vice Chair Rep. Mikie Sherrill also ranked highly on the informed ballot.

[An AP article](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=a4b96b306e&e=33f53a5b1a) covering the national poll is linked below. With Honor also released its data on the 495 veterans ran for Congress this cycle versus prior cycles. That data and analysis can be found at our press release [linked here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=a62b23a56b&e=33f53a5b1a).

| **Veterans Polling at Top of National Preference for Vice President**
Published 11:54 AM EDT, July 30, 2024 WASHINGTON, July 30, 2024 /PRNewswire/ -- Ipsos and With Honor released a national survey regarding voter preference for Vice Presidential candidates for the Democratic ticket. Former astronaut and Navy captain, Arizona Senator Mark Kelly, and Army veteran, Maryland Governor Wes Moore, top the list of candidates at 50% of voters assessing them each, respectively, as “very strong” and “strong” candidates for vice president. Pete Buttigieg, a Navy veteran and Secretary of Transportation, placed third with 42% followed by Michigan Governor, Gretchen Whitmer, at 38% and California Governor, Gavin Newsom, at 35%.

The poll shows Donald Trump and Kamala Harris statistically tied at 38%. Toplines and cross tabs are posted [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=8ef7212442&e=33f53a5b1a). The poll also assessed the impact of military experience on voter preferences across party lines. Twenty-six percent of Americans ranked military experience as the best choice for producing elected officials, and 47% of Americans ranked a military career in the top two preferences for past work experience for elected officials across party lines. Furthermore, the poll found that Americans ranked honesty, a trait often associated with military service, as the most appealing attribute for elected officials. Fifty-nine percent of respondents ranked this in the top two preferred traits, followed by a “willingness to fight for what’s important” (43%) and having the “right values” (42%). Veterans comprise 18% of Congress today, which is down from a high water mark of 72% decades ago when Congress was far less polarized. While 31 of 46 U.S. Presidents served previously in the military, it has been 15 years since a military veteran has held either the Presidency or Vice Presidency. It has been 28 years since both vice presidential candidates were veterans. A surge of post 9-11 veterans have run for Congress this cycle across party lines. With Honor also released its results from tracking all veteran Congressional races today. You can find that data [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=b942353680&e=33f53a5b1a).

All the way back in 1870, Hiram Rhodes Revels, a pastor and State Senator from Mississippi, was elected as the first Black US Senator. Since then, we've come a long way as a country. **But representation – like our democracy – is a work in progress, and I believe we can do better.**

Black Americans have long faced far too many obstacles like: discrimination, lower pay, higher job instability – not to mention the racist voter suppression laws that Texas Republicans like Ted Cruz have championed, which make it harder for certain folks to vote.

| **The Republican Party in the Virgin Islands Announces Slate of Nominees for November Election**
**U.S. Virgin Islands, July 31, 2024 –** The Republican Party in the Virgin Islands is pleased to announce the official slate of nominees for the upcoming November 5th General Election, following a unanimous decision by the State Committee during a special meeting held on July 30th.
The official nominees are:
1\. Ronald Pickard - Candidate for Delegate to Congress2\. Krystal Hardy - Candidate for Senate (STX)3\. Franz A. Christian Jr. - Candidate for Board of Elections (STX)4\. Sophia del Rosario - Candidate for Board of Elections (STT/STJ)5\. Barbara LaRonde - Candidate for Board of Elections (STT/STJ)6\. Derrick A. Callwood - Candidate for Senate (STT/STJ)7\. Collister Fahie - Candidate for Senate (STT/STJ)
These are the only officially recognized Republican nominees for the upcoming election.
Chairman John Yob commented on the nominations, saying, “We appreciate the judge's decision reserving our rights as a political party to determine our own nominees and process. Our territorial committee unanimously voted to nominate every candidate who participated in our nomination process. We have a tremendous group of Republican nominees, and we look forward to offering the territory strongalternatives to the status quo in November.”
The Republican Party in the Virgin Islands encourages the community to learn more about the nominees and their platforms as they prepare for the upcoming election. The Party is committed to presenting a diverse and capable group of individuals who are ready to address the key issues facing the Virgin Islands.
For further details about the nominees, please visit RPVI.org.

If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cybersecurity academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election year in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing my end-of-month goal would be sending a crystal-clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.** **[_So please, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. to help me continue our fight for progress this year? | | Peter, It’s April Cao.

When my husband Hung decided to run for the U.S. Senate, it wasn’t a solo decision. It was something we prayed about as a family, because we knew whatever came our way, we’d have to work as a team.

Now, I’m so excited for what’s to come in the next few months, and I’m so excited to be working with patriots like you to send my husband to the U.S. Senate.

But if we’re going to win, we have to get down to business.

We’ve set an ambitious **$10K Goal** for our end of month deadline at **midnight tonight** , and right now, we’re about halfway there.

body:
I will expose corruption, no matter what party they belong to!

View this email in your browser (https://us18.campaign-archive.com/?e=662ba75570&u=608f5f1c5767bda1edf1ae151&id=c3dffe31cb)

Fellow Patriots,

A State Supreme Court Justice was recently placed on administrative leave, without explanation (https://www.wmur.com/article/new-hampshire-supreme-court-justice-marconi-leave/61708982?fbclid=IwY2xjawEWK8xleHRuA2FlbQIxMQABHWMA-7GUoLeXBERWUEL6Uz2cWzbzakrFD4nEKx2GtJGD05wmRNV-XP6lNA_aem_Ma1q6S1Oe8xpIPqdycNe3w&utm_source=Burns+for+Congress&utm_campaign=c3dffe31cb-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_16_07_04_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-82c9aeec6f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) . It is totally unacceptable that we are left in the dark when there is a potentially serious violation of the public’s trust by a powerful judge.

To make matters worse, her husband was placed on administrative leave without explanation in April from his job managing our state’s Port Authority. He’s currently facing an investigation by the Attorney General’s office and there is still no public information as to why.
https://www.wmur.com/article/new-hampshire-supreme-court-justice-marconi-leave/61708982?fbclid=IwY2xjawEWK8xleHRuA2FlbQIxMQABHWMA-7GUoLeXBERWUEL6Uz2cWzbzakrFD4nEKx2GtJGD05wmRNV-XP6lNA_aem_Ma1q6S1Oe8xpIPqdycNe3w&utm_source=Burns+for+Congress&utm_campaign=c3dffe31cb-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_16_07_04_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-82c9aeec6f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

This kind of thing is typical of the Concord Uniparty Swamp. The insiders cover up the facts and leave the public in the dark. As your Executive Councilor I will shine a light on this behavior and expose corruption, no matter what party they belong to!

- Robert Burns

Candidate for Executive Council, District 4

In February of last year, the organization I started from a carriage house my grandfather built ousted me.

Project Veritas was at its peak at the time, having just released a bombshell investigation into Pfizer and its dangerous COVID research.

While those were the darkest days of my life, I knew my work had to continue. I developed a new passion for my lifelong career of being an undercover investigative journalist.

Then, just when my new company, O'Keefe Media Group, was getting off the ground, the remaining board members of Project Veritas filed a federal lawsuit against me.

The case remains active, and **[I'm asking for your help defending myself against this unjust attack designed to end my career](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxszzGvnDAMB_BPYzYQOByhQ4a2J97QqmvVqXISc5cKE14ID_HtK9CpU8f885PtP8kyhfEwoL8A4jP4FRBBfQbE91-7pO2PfHsrf77x9_K9-yG38xe_AmI-Fv5HX1MqFgrTmep74Y0afd0WbBqN2N5013bF09jRKu0d9USN85bcJ-zbcex7Itto5iIYrLGttWqwRt3oSlHfK2Vv3vej11pDW197KhJOwVGz5p1SilEqF6WYzDPnZb0OGwCHld2WuKKZfcynABymYDnlo3xslDzgEOVReh55Xrn8CC7HdJRiy8uCGrYsv9e4Jceg7v-xgN1JhH3Y5CKvJHM633tqXoEjWSg8ZlB3sYAdSdzmDOqOtyIZv-xhmsLanR0fV8ez0YfBvwEAAP__oxOHaw).**

This week, I spent hours in a courtroom testifying in the case against me.

I could have avoided it.

I could have given in and settled, saving myself and, OMG, the risk and expense of a trial.

But I will never compromise. I will never give in to the powers that try to silence me.

**As long as you have my back, I will NEVER surrender.**

This week's hearing was in response to an injunction Project Veritas filed against me. The primary demand they had requested from the court was to stop me from reaching out to Project Veritas donors.

If you've previously donated to Project Veritas, **that means you.**

Hundreds of thousands of Americans rightfully supported the organization I started. While I appreciated every hard-earned dollar that made my work possible, it is impossible for anyone to recall every name on such a massive list of supporters.

If Project Veritas' request were upheld, I would be in violation of the court by sending you this email.

Thankfully, the trial judge denied their motion, and my work and my communication with you continue.

It was a massive victory for my amazing legal team, and I thank God for the result.

But it's not over yet, and the case continues, and so do the legal expenses, so please, **[help cover my costs by donating to my legal defense fund hosted by Liberty Guard.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxszzGvnDAMB_BPYzYQOByhQ4a2J97QqmvVqXISc5cKE14ID_HtK9CpU8f885PtP8kyhfEwoL8A4jP4FRBBfQbE91-7pO2PfHsrf77x9_K9-yG38xe_AmI-Fv5HX1MqFgrTmep74Y0afd0WbBqN2N5013bF09jRKu0d9USN85bcJ-zbcex7Itto5iIYrLGttWqwRt3oSlHfK2Vv3vej11pDW197KhJOwVGz5p1SilEqF6WYzDPnZb0OGwCHld2WuKKZfcynABymYDnlo3xslDzgEOVReh55Xrn8CC7HdJRiy8uCGrYsv9e4Jceg7v-xgN1JhH3Y5CKvJHM633tqXoEjWSg8ZlB3sYAdSdzmDOqOtyIZv-xhmsLanR0fV8ez0YfBvwEAAP__oxOHaw)**

A day after the ruling, Project Veritas posted on X saying, “What this ruling means is that we will now move on to mediation again – something we have attempted for over a year with James.”

My response was clear before they posted that.

I will never surrender **[as long as you are by my side in support](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxszzGvnDAMB_BPYzYQOByhQ4a2J97QqmvVqXISc5cKE14ID_HtK9CpU8f885PtP8kyhfEwoL8A4jP4FRBBfQbE91-7pO2PfHsrf77x9_K9-yG38xe_AmI-Fv5HX1MqFgrTmep74Y0afd0WbBqN2N5013bF09jRKu0d9USN85bcJ-zbcex7Itto5iIYrLGttWqwRt3oSlHfK2Vv3vej11pDW197KhJOwVGz5p1SilEqF6WYzDPnZb0OGwCHld2WuKKZfcynABymYDnlo3xslDzgEOVReh55Xrn8CC7HdJRiy8uCGrYsv9e4Jceg7v-xgN1JhH3Y5CKvJHM633tqXoEjWSg8ZlB3sYAdSdzmDOqOtyIZv-xhmsLanR0fV8ez0YfBvwEAAP__oxOHaw). I pledge never to compromise our shared values and will go the distance to a jury verdict in ALL court cases against me. **

I'd rather die on my feet than live on my knees. When you have the truth in your heart, you have nothing to fear.

I will never surrender . I pledge never to compromise our shared values and will go the distance to a jury verdict in ALL court cases against me. I'd rather die on my feet than live on my knees. When you have the truth in your heart, you have nothing to fear. Thank you for your time and continued support, and please . In Truth, James O’Keefe Founder and CEO O'Keefe Media Group P.S. name: Team AOC
subject: You are not an ATM
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Are you on other political email lists?
If so, you probably regularly receive urgent and panicky emails asking for money — especially right now at the end of the quarter. Too many politicians and organizations see their grassroots supporters as an ATM machine. They use scare tactics, guilt and shame, and downright misleading language to coax people into donating.
It’s bad, and getting worse. Team AOC is determined to rise above that and treat you and our other grassroots supporters with respect. Here’s what we believe:
* Instead of scaring you to donate, we want to inspire you to take action.
* Instead of guilt tripping you for not donating enough, we want our emails to provide value to you. We try to send out informative, educational content.
* Instead of misleading you about fake 5X matches or faux threats, we’re honest with you about what’s going on and how you can help.
* Instead of only hitting you up when we need money, we’ll also send you opportunities to volunteer or help other candidates and causes who need it.

**But just like all the other campaigns in your inbox, we do have fundraising goals and deadlines.** Everything we raise each quarter is detailed in our public FEC report, and we want to post the biggest possible fundraising numbers. But we’re not going to scare or scam you into donating. We’ll just ask nicely because your donations to AOC are important and meaningful.
[**Would you be able to make a $5 donation to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez right now to help us hit our end-of-month goal? We’d really appreciate it.**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240731.QX7f1_&refcode=em20240731-6899-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6899%2E2526796%2EW-qo3d)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240731.QX7f1_&refcode=em20240731-6899-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=6899%2E2526796%2EW-qo3d)**
If you can’t make a donation today, that’s okay too. We still want you here, and we still appreciate you reading our emails.
The truth is that this email list is powerful. It’s powerful precisely because _you’re_ here with so many others. It’s powerful because when so many of us take collective action all at once, we can make real change.
So, maybe you can’t [**donate right now**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240731.QX7f1_&refcode=em20240731-6899-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6899%2E2526796%2EW-qo3d). But maybe you’ll get something of value from the next email we send. Or perhaps you’ll join us for a volunteer activity down the road.
No matter what: **we’re glad you’re here**. Thank you for being part of this movement.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20240731?refcode=em20240731-6899-P_FND_EOM_GOL&t=22&refcode2=6899_2526796_W-qo3d&akid=6899%2E2526796%2EW-qo3d)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20240731-6899-P_FND_EOM_GOL&t=23&akid=6899%2E2526796%2EW-qo3d)**

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, PO Box 680080, Corona, NY 11368.

| At this unprecedented juncture in American history, our fight has never been more important. In the past three weeks, we've seen an assassination attempt on President Trump, Washington insiders' ongoing deception to the American people about Joe Biden's capacity, a relentless attack on democracy by the Democrats, and the launch of a campaign for one of the most extreme liberals in the country.

Let me be clear: Democrats at every level have supported policies that have led to rising inflation, an open border, and soft-on-crime policies that threaten our communities and strain American families. From the beginning, Democrats have been out of touch with the needs of Americans, the values of District Two, and their ability to take this seat. This is why I am running to fight for Alabama families, District Two, and the majority.

Two weeks ago, at the Republican National Convention, the GOP laid out a vision for a wealthier, safer, and stronger America. I was proud to be in Milwaukee and witness our party's unity and sense of purpose as we work to re-elect President Trump, flip the Senate, and increase our majority in the House, starting with this seat in AL-02.

Earlier this month, Team Dobson completed the second quarter of fundraising with a strong report of $545,038, placing me among the top ten non-incumbent GOP candidates running for Congress and $50,000 ahead of my opponent.

Americans are ready to get our country back on the right track, and it shows. With your continued support, we're working hard and more equipped than ever to save our country come November.

Sincerely,
Caroleene Dobson

body:
| The path to winning the White House and the Senate runs right through Wisconsin.

body:
Are we the only campaign you get emails from?
#
Hey Derek, quick question:
Are we the only campaign you get emails from? We’re betting the answer to that is a resounding “nope.”
In fact, you probably get a _lot_ of emails from a _lot_ of different campaigns and organizations. And if we’re still betting, a lot of those emails from other folks probably don’t treat you with the respect you deserve.
**They may even treat you more like a piggy bank than a valued supporter. 🙄**
Look, every campaign, including this one, has to raise money ([**so please, pitch in to support ours if you can**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240731?refcode=em20240731&amount=5&refcode2=9253_434096_QIzw_w&akid=9253%2E434096%2EQIzw_w)). But here are just a few examples of the kind of scammy, dishonest tactics you’ll _never_ see from John:
_**“URGENT: FINAL NOTICE ENCLOSED”
**_ _**“4X MATCH ACTIVE!”
**_ _**“DONATE NOW OR WE WILL LOSE!”**_
We don’t engage in that kind of BS because we know you’re _not_ a piggy bank. **You’re a real person** , with a real job, a real life, and real concerns. And you deserve to be treated like one too.
So while we do count on grassroots donations to keep this campaign running, we’ll always be up front and honest about what we’re asking for and why.
**Here’s why we’re asking today: Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is at midnight tonight, and we still need a little help to reach our goal. Reaching these goals is REALLY important if we want to keep this seat 🔵.**
[**So if you can, please pitch in $5 before midnight to help us reach our July goal. We do need your help, but we promise to never try and trick you into donating.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240731?refcode=em20240731&amount=5&refcode2=9253_434096_QIzw_w&akid=9253%2E434096%2EQIzw_w)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240731?amount=5&refcode=em20240731-9253&refcode2=9253_434096_QIzw_w&akid=9253%2E434096%2EQIzw_w)**
Thanks,
Team Fetterman

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20240731-9253-footer&t=1&refcode2=9253_434096_QIzw_w&akid=9253%2E434096%2EQIzw_w)**

Peter — sorry if that subject line sounded a little ominous.
But that’s the point we’re reaching. As of this morning we are officially in the General Election — less than 100 days out. And we’ve got high marks that we need to hit if we’re going to win in Arizona.
It’s going to take a lot of work to get us across the finish line, to hold onto the Senate and defeat Trump and Lake. But more than that, it’s going to take a huge team to get there.
Our average donation is about $30 right now. We typically ask for a smaller donation than that, maybe $5 or $10, but today we’re going to ask you to match that average of $30.
If everybody reading this right now chipped in we’d absolutely DEMOLISH our goals. We wouldn’t need to ask again for weeks, and we’d be well on our way to victory.
But most folks who read this won’t chip in — that’s just the truth. And that’s why it’s all the more important that you chip in, if you can. Because we need the folks who understand how important their support truly is right now.
So, how about it, Peter.

body:

Peter,

I am excited to share that the Michigan Chronicle has officially endorsed
my candidacy for U.S. Senate! With the election on August 6th fast
approaching, this endorsement is incredibly meaningful, and I hope it
inspires voters across Michigan to support our campaign.

The Michigan Chronicle states, "Hill Harper, an acclaimed actor, author,
and philanthropist, announced his candidacy for Michigan’s U.S. Senate
seat just over a year ago, and the Michigan Chronicle proudly endorses
him." I am deeply honored by their endorsement, recognizing our shared
vision for a brighter future for Michigan.

Our state faces critical challenges, from economic disparities and
educational inequities to environmental concerns and healthcare access.
The Chronicle highlights my "multifaceted approach to combatting these
issues" and praises my "commitment to criminal justice reform, economic
revitalization, and educational advancement."

My journey has always been about resilience and dedication. With degrees
from Brown University and Harvard Law School, I’ve committed myself to
public service through extensive community work and founding The Manifest
Your Destiny Foundation. The Michigan Chronicle acknowledges my "blend of
intellect, compassion, and dedication to transparency," which they believe
makes me the ideal candidate for U.S. Senate.

This is a pivotal moment for Michigan. My leadership promises to bring a
new era of advocacy and action to the U.S. Senate. But I can't do this
alone—I need your help. Time is running out, and we urgently need your
support to ensure our message reaches every corner of Michigan.

[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2116?t=1002&akid=1312%2E62735%2EvgSZBW ]Donate now to join us in this exciting journey. Together, we can build
a stronger, more equitable future for all Michiganders.DONATE »[ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2117?t=1003&akid=1312%2E62735%2EvgSZBW ]You can
read the full endorsement at this link. Thank you for standing with me and
for your commitment to a better Michigan.

Hill Harper
Candidate for U.S. Senate

Michigan? We need boots on the ground to ensure every vote is counted and
every voice is heard. Can you commit to volunteering a few hours on
Election Day? Whether it's making calls, knocking on doors, or helping at
the polls, your time is invaluable. [ https://act.hillharper.com/go/2114?t=1004&akid=1312%2E62735%2EvgSZBW ]VOLUNTEER HERE »

I’ll never forget it.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89969644/488993799/1328794144?refcode=ea.906a3bca-824f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.906a3bca-824f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkwNmEzYmNhLTgyNGYtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z3R_M43arPwREN_6bZOsRu-wHQbia_K9ceuaBry57QI=&emci=94b6aa6d-574f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=906a3bca-824f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)
---
I recently spoke about my 2019 stint in jail on the podcast _Where Everybody Knows Your Name_ , hosted by Ted Danson and Woody Harrelson. It was an experience that I’ll never forget. Before I tell you the story, can I ask for a favor? Would you be willing to chip in a few dollars today to support the Jane Fonda Climate PAC? Your contribution will help us continue the fight for climate justice and support candidates who are committed to combatting the climate crisis: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jane-bax-email](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89969645/488993800/2105508926?refcode=ea.906a3bca-824f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.906a3bca-824f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkwNmEzYmNhLTgyNGYtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z3R_M43arPwREN_6bZOsRu-wHQbia_K9ceuaBry57QI=)** Picture this: It’s my 82nd birthday. I’m in a Washington, D.C. jail cell, having just been arrested for the fifth time — this time for protesting the government’s inaction on addressing the climate crisis. It was me, some cockroaches, and my red coat, which also served that night as my pillow and my blanket. As I lay there, I reflected on the stark disparities in our society. Listen, I’m white and famous. I knew someone was coming to pick me up the next day. I was keenly aware that my treatment was far better than many of the women around me. The jail was filled with the sounds of anguish, with screams and shouts echoing down the halls. Many of those women needed mental health care, _not_ incarceration. But even with my privilege, I felt a sense of liberation in aligning my body with my deepest values through civil disobedience. Civil disobedience is more than just a protest. It's putting your entire self on the line for what you believe in. It’s a way to draw attention to the urgent issues we face and demand change. For me, that night in jail wasn’t just about protesting the climate crisis; it was about showing solidarity with those who are most affected by climate injustice. The communities being impacted most by climate disasters aren’t the wealthy, majority-white neighborhoods in Beverly Hills or Manhattan. It’s the folks in Louisiana along the Gulf Coast in “Cancer Alley.” These are what the fossil fuel industry calls “sacrifice zones” — people of color, communities below the poverty line, people who depend on shrimping and fishing for their livelihoods. Their businesses and their lives are being destroyed by the fossil fuel industry while their economic circumstances leave little room for escape. **I realized that as a woman with privilege and a platform, I had to do more to help empower and uplift the voices of these communities. As much as my protesting, marching, and civil disobedience helped further our cause, I knew I had to come to terms with the fact that nothing was going to change at the scale we need if we didn’t change the people in power.** That’s where JanePAC comes in. Our mission is to elect candidates at every level of government who understand the urgency of the climate crisis and are willing to back bold climate solutions. We channel the spirit of protest into electoral power, ensuring that our voices are heard where it can make a meaningful impact — in the halls of government. This year’s election cycle could be our last chance to secure a livable, sustainable future, and we can’t do it alone. We need your support to continue this fight. So, I’m humbly asking you to join me. **[Donate to my climate PAC today, join a climate protest, educate others about what’s at stake, and vote for candidates who will fight for climate justice. Together, we can make a difference.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89969646/488993801/2105508926?refcode=ea.906a3bca-824f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.906a3bca-824f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkwNmEzYmNhLTgyNGYtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z3R_M43arPwREN_6bZOsRu-wHQbia_K9ceuaBry57QI=)** | [**DONATE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89969647/488993802/2105508926?refcode=ea.906a3bca-824f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.906a3bca-824f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkwNmEzYmNhLTgyNGYtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z3R_M43arPwREN_6bZOsRu-wHQbia_K9ceuaBry57QI=)

clean_body: I’ll never forget it. | I recently spoke about my 2019 stint in jail on the podcast Where Everybody Knows Your Name , hosted by Ted Danson and Woody Harrelson. It was an experience that I’ll never forget. Before I tell you the story, can I ask for a favor? Would you be willing to chip in a few dollars today to support the Jane Fonda Climate PAC? Your contribution will help us continue the fight for climate justice and support candidates who are committed to combatting the climate crisis: = Picture this: It’s my 82nd birthday. I’m in a Washington, D.C. jail cell, having just been arrested for the fifth time — this time for protesting the government’s inaction on addressing the climate crisis. It was me, some cockroaches, and my red coat, which also served that night as my pillow and my blanket. As I lay there, I reflected on the stark disparities in our society. Listen, I’m white and famous. I knew someone was coming to pick me up the next day. I was keenly aware that my treatment was far better than many of the women around me. The jail was filled with the sounds of anguish, with screams and shouts echoing down the halls. Many of those women needed mental health care, not incarceration. But even with my privilege, I felt a sense of liberation in aligning my body with my deepest values through civil disobedience. Civil disobedience is more than just a protest. It's putting your entire self on the line for what you believe in. It’s a way to draw attention to the urgent issues we face and demand change. For me, that night in jail wasn’t just about protesting the climate crisis; it was about showing solidarity with those who are most affected by climate injustice. The communities being impacted most by climate disasters aren’t the wealthy, majority-white neighborhoods in Beverly Hills or Manhattan. It’s the folks in Louisiana along the Gulf Coast in “Cancer Alley.” These are what the fossil fuel industry calls “sacrifice zones” — people of color, communities below the poverty line, people who depend on shrimping and fishing for their livelihoods. Their businesses and their lives are being destroyed by the fossil fuel industry while their economic circumstances leave little room for escape. I realized that as a woman with privilege and a platform, I had to do more to help empower and uplift the voices of these communities. As much as my protesting, marching, and civil disobedience helped further our cause, I knew I had to come to terms with the fact that nothing was going to change at the scale we need if we didn’t change the people in power. That’s where JanePAC comes in. Our mission is to elect candidates at every level of government who understand the urgency of the climate crisis and are willing to back bold climate solutions. We channel the spirit of protest into electoral power, ensuring that our voices are heard where it can make a meaningful impact — in the halls of government. This year’s election cycle could be our last chance to secure a livable, sustainable future, and we can’t do it alone. We need your support to continue this fight. So, I’m humbly asking you to join me. = | = In solidarity, Jane Fonda = P.S. **Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

body:
| Peter, I know I’ve been sharing a lot of old photos recently, but I just had to send this to you.

Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89970645/488996967/-972566244?amount=10&refcode=RTFC_20240731_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmNkNzQwNi04NDRmLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VTLVu16MqdFnUmPhjDM2ClRQYybjdfpXvo6YU3bZZYA=) I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith.

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause.

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.

We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.

This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: The crypto lobby has been pretty upset with me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This campaign relies on a large number of supporters pitching in a little at a time

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2292%2E4032634%2EWr1gnT)
---
You know, ever since I began speaking out about how the crypto industry should follow the same basic rules as banks and all other financial institutions, the crypto lobby has been pretty upset with me, and has been working to defeat me. [**If you’re fired up now to defeat these special interests like them who are trying to buy elections and hand-pick politicians who only work for them, please pitch in here. I’ll explain more below.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2536?t=8&akid=2292%2E4032634%2EWr1gnT) So they recruited a crypto-lawyer from Rhode Island to run against me. He’s a self-funder who can donate $1 million to his campaign at a time. And the crypto lobby is also pouring money into this race. Just this past month, we found out that a Super PAC supporting my opponent raked in $2 million from three massive donations — from two crypto billionaires and one big crypto firm. **To put that into perspective: That’s over half a million more than our campaign had raised in the three months prior. Just like that.** They’re hellbent on defeating me because I’m fighting for fair consumer protections and working families instead of their bottom line. Not to mention, defeating me in Massachusetts would virtually guarantee a GOP-controlled Senate. So while those billionaires and special interests are supporting my opponent, we need to respond with strong, grassroots support. Look, I know for certain that our movement is stronger than theirs, but this campaign relies on a large number of supporters pitching in a little at a time vs. a small number of billionaires and special interests pitching in a lot at a time. In the latest fundraising quarter, the average amount people donated to our campaign was about $25. That is a sign of how we are building a grassroots campaign. And that is exactly the type of campaign I want to run — one that centers working people, advocates for working people, and puts power in the hands of working people. Thousands of supporters chipping in $25 at a time — vs. two billionaires and one company fueling a Super PAC. I’ll take this team any day of the week. But this type of grassroots fundraising model only works if everyone keeps pitching in whatever they can, whenever they can. [**This is the difference between a government that works great for those at the top and a government that can work for everyone. So can you please pitch in $25 or anything you can right now to respond to this Super PACs funding with a strong surge of grassroots support for my re-election campaign?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2537?t=9&akid=2292%2E4032634%2EWr1gnT)

Hi Peter,
The Republican presidential ticket supports **Project 2025** , a far-reaching and extreme policy platform that would negatively transform America as we know it, including cutting vital care services and worsen the affordability crisis.
“The conservative policy platform Project 2025 could result in cuts to the long-term care services on which millions of Americans depend.

The plan, published by the conservative think tank the Heritage Foundation, outlines a policy playbook for a future conservative administration. The roughly 900‐page document includes changes that would likely result in cuts to Medicaid... **This includes home-based and nursing home care for roughly six million Americans, both older adults and younger adults who have disabilities and chronic illnesses.”**

\- Barrons, July 19, 2024

body:
June Update

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/crouchforindiana/ppp2gaxknr-12703106?e=8f9fef7158)
July Update
Friends and Fellow Hoosiers,

Thank you to all who were able to join our Mental Health Matters Roundtable in Madison this month. It was a successful event, filled with meaningful conversation. I look forward to more of these events throughout the state - stay tuned!
Suzanne Crouch
Playbook for Enhancing Indiana's Mental and Behavioral Health Workforce
This month, the IU Bowen Center released their "Playbook for Enhancing Indiana's Mental and Behavioral Health Workforce (https://buff.ly/3VNvco8?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=e4ba7efb6f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ", giving a list of four recommendations of how Indiana can address the workforce shortage we face when it comes to addressing mental health.
https://buff.ly/3VNvco8?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=e4ba7efb6f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
LEARN MORE (https://buff.ly/3VNvco8?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=e4ba7efb6f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
OCRA's Building Socially Connected Communities
I've had the opportunity to share OCRA's new grant program, Building Socially Connected Communities, to address the loneliness epidemic. Learn more below!
Noblesville Mental Health Roundtable with Mayor Jensen
I was honored to have Noblesville Mayor Chris Jensen join me for a mental health conversation with many community leaders this month. We discussed a number of issues, from how community partnerships are filling the gaps of services, to the resources the Indiana Mental Health Roundtable provides. It was a bonus to meet Luna and Sadie, Noblesville's therapy K9s!

In The News

This month, I spoke with Dee Dotson on Regionally Speaking about the epidemic of loneliness. Click the button below to learn more about our new grant program, Building Socially Connected Communities.

If we can hit our fundraising goal by the end of the day, we’ll be able to reach, register, and mobilize thousands of new voters — voters who will be the key to flipping Texas blue.

Hi Peter, One of the reasons I ran for Congress was because I could relate to the plight of being under-served and unheard. I’ve lived in this district my whole life, and there has been no shortage of problems needing solutions. From our education hubs to our rural communities, each issue is complex and nuanced. But with so many problems to solve, issues affecting marginalized folks are often pushed to the back burner. For so long, I wanted someone running for Congress who could relate to the experiences of the diverse community in NC-04 and prioritize progress. **Until one day I realized, I could be that person.** I’m not in this for fame or ego, I’m in Congress to ensure every need is met for every single person who calls this district home. clean_body: | Voting is a fundamental right, team. That’s why protecting and expanding access to the ballot box has been a critical part of my agenda as governor. I’ve signed legislation that makes it easier for voters to get to the polls, expands voter registration opportunities, protects poll workers from intimidation tactics, and more. I’ve also expanded voter registration opportunities for veterans and small business owners. But just a few days ago, Donald Trump and the Republican National Committee filed a lawsuit against me because of my work helping veterans and small business owners register to vote. = | = Here’s some background information: In accordance with federal law, I designated several Department of Veterans Affairs and Small Business Administration offices as voter registration agencies — which allows them to provide Michiganders with voter registration information and assist them with the process. Donald Trump is now suing me, actively trying to block veterans and small business owners from registering at these new registration sites. Every eligible Michigander who wants to vote deserves the opportunity to do so. That includes our veterans who have put their lives on the line to keep us safe and our small business owners who make up the backbone of our economy. I’m disappointed that Donald Trump and his allies disagree, but I will always stand up for our fundamental rights. Our democracy is stronger when people from all backgrounds and walks of life make their voices heard, and I’m committed to ensuring that every Michigander can exercise their right to vote. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = | = = | = = Thank you for standing alongside me. — Gretchen Fight Like Hell PAC PO Box 15093 Lansing, MI 48901 United States ** | mailto:info@fightlikehellpac.org| | Paid for by Fight Like Hell PAC

body:
| | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us21.campaign-archive.com/?e=9e637674b4&i=*|ITERATION_UNIQUE_ID|*&u=6915dcf45e69335acd266178e&id=0352064216)
---
Peter,
Thank you again for signing up for our email updates – I’m grateful to have you on board. Since launching my campaign, I promised to never turn my back on the State of Wyoming. That isn’t always the case in politics.
**Unfortunately, our Senator, John Barrasso, is more concerned with replacing Mitch McConnell as Majority Leader than representing us**. Making his constituency the Senators in Washington, DC, not the people of Wyoming. Washington needs a change. We need people in office who serve the people who elected them, not themselves. This means delivering on key issues and promises made.
|
---
| [Learn More About Campaign Key Issues](https://rasner4wy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6915dcf45e69335acd266178e&id=522521a007&e=9e637674b4&i=5a5b6e7f82)
---
|
---
**I'm not simply running against Senator Barrasso, as some may perceive, particularly within the corridors of Washington, D.C. I'm running as the voice of Wyoming, to champion the values that define our great state. It's high time we had representation in our nation’s capital that truly embodies the spirit of Wyoming.**
|

Patriot,

name: Chris Coulombe | Chris to Congress
subject: We’re making the Democrats nervous about CA-2
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY COMMITTEE TO ELECT CHRIS COULOMBE TO CONGRESS
body:
They haven’t had to worry about California’s 2nd Congressional District in years. Our message is reaching and impacting swing voters who are tired of the status quo.

| | | [ ](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BQAYW9EUFvM40fZI212DCbwUqgYAVDZjrRyhX3p-fRKhz19ejbFcmNPIjtrnjtyYAHl-g9FaMnzj0gPSE2OUESa&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=were_making_the_democrats_ner&n=1)
---
---
Friend, At times, it’s possible I have not been direct enough when asking for campaign support. **I’ll speak plainly.** We’re making the Democrats nervous. They haven’t had to worry about California’s 2nd Congressional District in years. For the first time in a decade they are spending big money to manage a campaign. Our message is reaching and impacting swing voters who are tired of the status quo. But we need the funds to reach all the voters across our district. We are all suffering, but we need to let the rest of the district know there is a fight and we are fighting! **Only together can we change our situation.** [We just need 1,000 people to give $100, or 100 people to give $1,000](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BQAYW9EUFvM40fZI212DCbwUqgYAVDZjrRyhX3p-fRKhz19ejbFcmNPIjtrnjtyYAHl-g9FaMnzj0gPSE2OUESa&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=were_making_the_democrats_ner&n=2). I know that’s not possible for everyone, but if you can spare it, I’m asking for your help. I’m sounding the alarm because this is serious. Our district is vast, nearly 13,000 square miles. It’s the 2nd largest Congressional district in the state. We can’t afford to stop knocking on doors, calling voters, or running ads. [You can make a big difference.](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BQAYW9EUFvM40fZI212DCbwUqgYAVDZjrRyhX3p-fRKhz19ejbFcmNPIjtrnjtyYAHl-g9FaMnzj0gPSE2OUESa&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=were_making_the_democrats_ner&n=3) **Thank you very much,**[](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BQAYW9EUFvM40fZI212DCbwUqgYAVDZjrRyhX3p-fRKhz19ejbFcmNPIjtrnjtyYAHl-g9FaMnzj0gPSE2OUESa&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=were_making_the_democrats_ner&n=4) [](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BQAYW9EUFvM40fZI212DCbwUqgYAVDZjrRyhX3p-fRKhz19ejbFcmNPIjtrnjtyYAHl-g9FaMnzj0gPSE2OUESa&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=were_making_the_democrats_ner&n=5) **Chris Coulombe
** Republican Nominee, California’s 2nd Congressional District

Friend,

I am happy to report that my legislation, the Kids Online Safety Act, just passed the Senate 91-3. After almost four years of relentless effort, the first internet safety reform in nearly three decades garnered resounding bipartisan approval.
Over the course of working on this legislation, my colleagues and I heard heartbreaking stories from families across the country. Stories about how internet platforms cause harm to children and teens: body image issues, addictive use of technology, promotion of dangerous products, and the fueling of bullying and other destructive behaviors.

This legislation forces Big Tech to act to protect our kids and gives children and parents alike the tools, safeguards, and transparency they need to stay safe online.

In addition to its bipartisan passage in the Senate, the Kids Online Safety Act has been endorsed by over 250 organizations and associations. But we aren’t over the finish line yet. **This legislation still needs to pass through the House of Representatives before going to President Biden’s desk for signature – and that’s why I’m reaching out for your help:**
[**I’ve launched a new petition calling on Speaker Johnson and the House to pass the Kids Online Safety Act, and I’m counting on your signature supporting this petition. Will you please sign on now to finally pass accountability for Big Tech into law so our kids can be safe online?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89976675/489017557/1725521699?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&code=jtk1375-su-nd1&refcode=jtk1375-su-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODI2NmY2OWEtOTA0Zi1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uBetivruhadPq2WXhWE9vlgVAGiFkzUqur_F_6ADs1E=&emci=e9fba708-6f4f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=8266f69a-904f-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=9329426)

In less than 100 days, we will protect the District 20 seat and show extremist lawmakers in our state legislature that we will not go back.
Before we cross this finish line, I need your help to ensure we can fund the voter outreach that will bring us to victory on November 5th.
Chip in today to help us reach our July fundraising goal! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/re-elect-heidi-email]

| | Congressman Russell Fry, South Carolina’s Seventh Congressional District Congressman, is honored and humbled to represent the Pee Dee and Grand Strand areas in Washington, D.C. Russell Fry is the successful product of the American Dream. He learned from his parents that there is no such thing as a free lunch and that success comes from hard work and determination. Russell self-funded his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina and then earned his law degree at the Charleston School of Law. In law school, he served as Student Bar Association president, helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation, and received the prestigious Civility Award. For over a decade, he practiced law all along the Grand Strand. Russell has always been a public servant and an advocate for the conservative movement. Prior to his election to U.S. Congress, Russell Fry represented Horry County in the South Carolina General Assembly. As Chief Majority Whip in the State House, he fought to lower taxes, defend the unborn, and safeguard the 2nd Amendment. Additionally, Russell fought to put 18 policy initiatives into law in his time as Chairman of the SC House Opioid Abuse Prevention Study Committee. This legislation provided funding for education on opioids, opioid prevention, and opioid treatment. Russell and his wife, Bronwen, have one son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their beloved chocolate lab, Jasper.
