“Truth to Power” isn’t just another set of buzzwords. We’re committed to holding special interests accountable—and we need your help to get it done.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39012%2E3422442%2EMijyLm)
Derek—Katie Porter here.
Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is almost here, and in a moment, I’m going to ask for your help reaching our goal. **But before I do, I want to take a moment to tell you how I chose the name of this organization.**
"Truth to Power" isn’t just another set of buzzwords. As an attorney, as a professor, as a bank watchdog, and as a Congresswoman, I have spent my entire career speaking truth to power.
In 2012, then-California Attorney General Kamala Harris appointed me to oversee a multi-billion dollar settlement that forced America’s biggest mortgage providers to take responsibility for bank servicing and foreclosure misconduct. I held the banks accountable—and delivered for Californians.
When I was elected to Congress, I made a name for myself as someone who held powerful special interests to account. With my whiteboard in tow, I spent hearing after hearing calling out corporate executives and others who put profits before consumers. And I passed legislation—to lower drug prices, to crack down on polluters, to close health insurance loopholes, and more.
Now that my time in Washington is coming to an end, I’m backing a new generation of leaders who will continue speaking truth to power in the halls of Congress. And that’s where this organization comes in.
**Truth to Power helps anti-corruption champions get the resources they need to win—without taking money from corporate PACs.** With the help of grassroots supporters like you—supporters who aren’t afraid to speak truth to power—we’ll elect the next wave of candidates who hold power accountable.
But we’re just a few months away from Election Day, and if we want to make sure our candidates win, we have got to hit our fundraising goal before the end of July. **[So Derek, will you speak truth to power today by chipping in $5 or more before our deadline passes?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240731?refcode=em20240731-39012&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39012_3422442_MijyLm&akid=39012%2E3422442%2EMijyLm)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240731?refcode=em20240731-39012&refcode2=39012_3422442_MijyLm&akid=39012%2E3422442%2EMijyLm)
Together, we will hold powerful interests accountable.
—Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240731-39012&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=39012_3422442_MijyLm&akid=39012%2E3422442%2EMijyLm)**

** Donate for Democracy!
------------------------------------------------------------

** "If You Want Democracy, You Have to Vote For It..."
------------------------------------------------------------

With the change in the top of the Democratic ticket, you're being bombarded with emails asking for your donation. I'll admit, this is another one, but donating to this cause will help underscore your investment in Kamala Harris (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=b80e4aa20b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_07_30_05_42_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ca9a65aa65-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

I was thrilled to be a part of the opening of the Democrat HQ in Forsyth County on Sunday. The event was full of undeniable energy that made me confident that Kamala will win in November. Unfortunately, the thought that followed that is "and Republicans will win control of Congress".

That thought terrifies me. All the hope we have now for our party will be blocked by the same kind of do-nothing Congress that has plagued us for far too long. To put it plainly, Democrats like me need to be elected to Congress to help secure the promise we feel right now and the best way to do that is to donate to Democratic Congressional Candidates. My name is Bob Christian and I am asking you to donate to my campaign for US House of Representatives for North Georgia's 7th congressional district. (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=b80e4aa20b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_07_30_05_42_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ca9a65aa65-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. Raised by a single mother in public housing, Ritchie personally understands the hardships that working families endure. At age 25, Ritchie made history as the youngest elected official to serve on the New York City Council. He fought tirelessly for the working families of The Bronx, and now, he's fighting for those families and for progressive values in Congress. body:
I ran against a guy like JD in Arizona back in 2022. MAGA Right, venture capitalist, backed by some shady tech billionaire out of Silicon Valley.
#

Team —
I’ve been watching JD Vance since he became a Senator back in 2023. And I’ve been paying a good bit more attention to him over the last couple weeks now that Trump named him as his running mate.
I ran against a guy like JD in Arizona in 2022. MAGA Right, venture capitalist, backed by a shady tech billionaire out of Silicon Valley.
**_We all know guys like this._** Guys that think they know better than everyone about everything. They think they know better than women and their doctors about abortion. They think they know better than seniors about Social Security and Medicare.
We can’t let guys like that lead us. We can’t let guys like that make decisions about our lives.
I’m all in to help Democrats win this year and make sure that does not happen. I’m backing up Kamala Harris with everything I’ve got. And today, I’m asking you to help.
